A chariot for a creeper, a shawl for a p: Eggaali y’omusezi, ekitambaala eri enkookooma, ekibala ekiwa obulamu eri omutontomi: ebirabo by’abaguzi ebisinga okumanyika birabika nga tebirina mugaso, era eyo y’ensonga yaabwe. A Chera coin in the collection of the Na: Effeeza ya Chera mu kukuŋŋaanyizibwa mu Napier Museum, Thiruvananthapuram. Effeeza za Chera mu ngeri ey’enjawulo zirina obutaasa n’obusaale, akabonero k’olulyo olwo, era ebyokulabirako bingi eby’edda biva mu Karur, ekifo ekikulu ekya Chera ku Amaravathi.
A chieftain of the Ay line in the southe: Omukulu w’olunyiriri lwa Ay mu nsi ey’obugwanjuba ey’ensozi eya Podiyil (Pothigai). Ennono emanyiddwa ennyo eyogera ku kuwaayo kwe ekyambalo eky’omuwendo eri katonda, ekimanyiddwa ennyo nga Shiva — okuwaayo ng’okwewaayo nga kw’otadde n’obugabi.
A chieftain of the Malaiyaman lineage, o: Omutaka w’olunyiriri lwa Malaiyaman, ow’eggwanga eryetoolodde Mullur ne Tirukkoyilur, yajjukirwanga olw’obulungi bwe eri abayimbi n’eri bonna abajja gy’ali. Ekifo kye mu bayambi omusanvu kiraga nti ekitiibwa ky’omufuzi kyapimibwanga ku kuwaayo kwe nga bwe kupimibwa mu kitundu kye.
A Chola coin carrying Pandya royal insig: Effeeza ya Chola eyali etisse obubonero bw’obwakabaka bwa Pandya. Abachola bwe baaleeta ensi ya Pandya wansi w’obufuzi bwabwe, baateeka ebyennyanja bya Pandya ku mabbali g’engo yaabwe — akabonero k’okuwangula akaakubwa mu kyuma.
A city where literature, royal patronage: Ekibuga ebiwandiiko, obuyambi bw’obwakabaka, eddiini n’obulamu bw’omu bibuga mwe bisisinkanye okumala emyaka nga enkumi bbiri.
A coin of Kulottunga Chola bearing the t: Effeeza ya Kulottunga Chola eriko omutwe “Malai Nadu konda Chola” — Abachola abaatwala ensi y’ensozi, kwe kugamba, ettaka ly’Abachera. Bakabaka ba Chola baalangirira obuwanguzi bwabwe mu bitiibwa ebyakubwa ku ssente zaabwe awamu n’okuyoolebwa mu biwandiiko byabwe.
A coin of Kulottunga I (1070–1120 CE), w: Effeeza ya Kulottunga I (1070–1120 C.E.), eyagatta ennyiriri z’Abachola n’Abachalukya ab’ebuvanjuba era n’afuga emu ku bufuzi bw’Abachola obusinga obuwanvu era obw’obugagga. Effeeza ze zigenda mu maaso n’ebika bya Chola ebyassibwawo n’erinnya lye mu lulimi Olunagari.
A coin of Rajaraja I. His copper coins o: Effeeza ya Rajaraja I. Effeeza ze ez’ekikomo ez’ekika kya kabaka ayimiridde n’ezitudde, ezayingizibwa oluvannyuma lw’okuwamba obukiikakkono bwa Sri Lanka, zaatambula nnyo ku njuyi zombi ez’ennyanja era zaakoppebwa okumala ebyasa bingi.
A coin of the Jaffna kingdom showing a h: Effeeza y’obwakabaka bwa Jaffna ng’eraga embalaasi ng’erina ebyennyanja. Bakabaka b’e Jaffna aba Tamil (ekyasa eky’ekkumi n’ettaano–ekkumi n’omusanvu) baafulumya ssente mu nnono y’Abayindi mu South, ekijjukiza enkolagana ey’oku lusegere eyaliwo emitala w’omugga Palk Strait.
A coin of the Kongu Cheras, the Chera li: Effeeza ya Kongu Cheras, olunyiriri lwa Chera olwafuga ensi ya Kongu ey’ekitundu ky’amaserengeta ga Tamil (okwetooloola Coimbatore, Erode ne Karur eza leero) — ekitundu kye kimu ekivuddemu ebikuŋŋaanyizo eby’ensimbi z’Abaruumi.
A crowned, moustached figure in profile,: Omusajja alina engule, ng’alina ebirevu mu profile, ng’ayambadde jaketi eriko amayinja ag’omuwendo n’engoye ezikulukuta, asitula omuggo oguliko amaliba. Feesi n’emikono bikubiddwa mu layini enjeru ennungi ku ttaka eriddugavu ate engoye zinaazibwa mu langi ya ochre, pink ne green — okunoonyereza okulinga ekifaananyi ku nnyambala y’omu lubiri mu kifaananyi kya yeekaalu.
A detail of the painted ceiling of the J: Ekintu ekikwata ku ssilingi eyasiigibwa langi ku kiggwa ky’empuku y’Abajayina e Sittanavasal: loosi eza pinki ezigguka wakati mu paadi eza kiragala, ekisolo ekiwuguka mu mazzi n’ekifaananyi ekikung’aanya ebimuli. Ekidiba kino kitera okusomebwa ng’omukutu gwa lotus ogwa samavasarana, olukiiko olw’omu ggulu omujain Tirthankara mw’abuulira, ng’abeesigwa bakuŋŋaanya ebimuli okuwaayo.
A funerary vessel from the burial cairns: Ekibya eky’okuziika okuva mu bifo eby’okuziikamu eby’obusozi bwa Nilgiri, ekibikka kyayo nga kiriko ebifaananyi eby’ekyokulabirako. Abasimi b’amayinja ga Nilgiri mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omwenda baazuula ebibikka bingi ng’ebyo nga waggulu biriko abantu, ebisolo n’abavuzi — ebifaananyi ebitonotono mu bbumba ebiyinza okulaga obulamu n’embeera y’abafu.
A garland of about a hundred and fifty a: Omukuufu ogw’ennyiriri za akam nga kikumi mu ataano eza Kanimethaviyar, ezimu amakumi asatu ku buli emu ku nkula y’ensi ettaano.
A gold coin of Rajaraja I (985–1014 CE),: Effeeza ya zaabu eya Rajaraja I (985–1014 C.E.), eyazimba yeekaalu ennene e Thanjavur. Kiraga akabonero k’obwakabaka aka Chola akamanyiddwa ennyo: engo etudde ng’eri ku mabbali g’ebyennyanja bibiri ebya Pandya, wansi w’akasolya ak’obufuzi, ng’erinnya lya kabaka liriko mu lulimi Olunagari — Abachola beegamba nti bafuga obugwanjuba.
A gold half-kahavanu of Virarajendra Cho: Ekitundu kya zaabu ekya kahavanu ekya Virarajendra Chola (1063–1070 C.E.). Kahavanu (okuva mu kahapana) yali ddiini ya zaabu eya Sri Lanka, era zaabu w’Abachola eyakubwa ku mutindo guno alaga ekiseera ky’obufuzi bw’Abachola ku kizinga kino.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiya: Ekitontome ekilungamya ku Idylls Ekkumi ekya Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar. Omubardi alina yazh ennene alagirwa okutuuka e Thondaiman Ilanthiraiyan ow’e Kanchi; mu kkubo ekitontome kisiiga ebifaananyi ebirabika obulungi eby’ebyalo, emyalo, n’abantu.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Mudath: Ekitontome ekilungamya ku Idylls Ekkumi ekya Mudathama Kanniyar. Omuyimbi akuba endongo (porunar) abadde afuna empeera nnyingi alungamya muyimbi munne eri kabaka omugabi w’Abachola Karikal Valavan.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Nallur: Ekitontome ekilungamya ku Idylls Ekkumi ekya Nallur Nathathanar. Omuyimbi akuba yazh entono (ennanga) akulembera omulala eri omukulu Nalliyakkodan, ng’annyonnyola ebizibu by’abayimbi abaavu n’ebbugumu ly’omuyambi omugabi.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Perunk: Ekitontome ekilungamya ku Idylls Ekkumi ekya Perunkausikanar. Abayimbi abataayaaya (koothar) balungamizibwa eri omukulu Nannan; ekitontome kino kikuzibwa olw’okukwata amaloboozi amangi ag’ensozi.
A large storage jar associated with Adic: Ekibbo ekinene eky’okuterekamu ebintu ekikwatagana ne Adichanallur. Ebibya ebinene byalimu emmere ey’empeke, amazzi n’ebintu ebirala; mu bifo eby’okuziikamu, ebibya eby’obunene bwe butyo nabyo byali bisobola okukola ng’ebibya. Ekigambo “dolio” kijjukiza dolium, ekibya ekinene eky’okuterekamu ebintu mu nsi y’Abaruumi.
A large, round-bellied funerary urn from: Ekibbo ekinene eky’okuziika ekyekulungirivu okuva mu Adichanallur. Ebibya nga bino byali bisobola okuyimirira nga biwanvu okusinga omwana, era okubikola kyali kyetaagisa obukugu bungi: Abayimbi ba Sangam boogera ku mubumbi eyakola ebibya nga கலம்செய் கோவே — “Ayi kabaka mu babumbi”.
A lead coin from Andipatti bearing a leg: Effeeza y’omusulo okuva e Andipatti ng’eriko olugero mu lulimi Olutamil-Brahmi. Ng’oggyeeko bakabaka abasatu abaali batikkiddwa engule, abaami b’omu kitundu ab’omulembe gwa Sangam baafulumyanga ssente ez’omusulo n’ekikomo, era enfumo z’Abatamil-Brahmi ezaawandiikibwako ziyamba okuteeka amannya eri abafuzi bano.
A line drawing of the vimana and a pilla: Ennyiriri ezikubiddwa vimana n’ekisenge eky’empagi ekya Brihadisvara Temple.
A love poem of the Ten Idylls by Kapilar: Ekitontome ky’omukwano ekya Ten Idylls ekya Kapilar, ekiteekeddwa mu nsozi (kurinji) landscape. Ennono egamba nti yawandiikibwa okuyigiriza kabaka w’obukiikakkono obulungi bw’ebitontome by’omukwano eby’Abatamil; kimanyiddwa nnyo okutuuma ebimuli kyenda mu mwenda.
A modern artist’s imagining of a busy ha: Omuyiiya ow’omulembe guno okulowooza ku mwalo ogulimu abantu abangi ogw’emmeeri, obutale n’eminaala, oluvannyuma lw’ennyonnyola mu Silappathikaram ne Pattinappalai. Si bukakafu ku ngeri ekibuga gye kyali kirabika mu butuufu.
A modern sketch imagining ships and buil: Sketch ey’omulembe ng’ekuba ekifaananyi ky’emmeeri n’ebizimbe ku mwalo ogw’edda. Okufaananako buli kuddamu okuzimba Puhar, kutaputa ennyonyola z’ebiwandiiko; ensengeka y’omwalo mu bujjuvu temanyiddwa.
A name linked with Nedunalvadai and Tiru: Erinnya erikwatagana ne Nedunalvadai ne Tirumurukarruppatai mu Ten Idylls — wadde nga liyinza okuba ery’abayimbi abasukka mu omu mu biseera eby’enjawulo. Enfumo ezaddirira zigamba ku kugaana kwe okuwaayo ensala ye ey’ekitontome wadde eri Shiva mu kkooti ya Pandya: akabonero k’obuvumu obw’amagezi, so si kintu kya byafaayo.
A palm-leaf manuscript from the museum’s: Ekiwandiiko eky’amakoola g’enkindu okuva mu nkuŋŋaanya mu myuziyamu.

A Pandya coin showing a standing king wi: Effeeza ya Pandya eraga kabaka ayimiridde ng’alina akabonero k’ebyennyanja. Ekifaananyi ky’omufuzi ayimiridde, ekyamanyisibwa olw’ensimbi z’ekikomo ez’Abachola, kyatwalibwa Abapandya obuyinza bwabwe bwe bwaddamu okuzuukuka mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’ettaano.
A Pandya coin with the twin fish and a b: Effeeza ya Pandya ng’eriko ebyennyanja ebibiri n’ente ennume. Ebyennyanja bino ebibiri byafuuka akabonero ka Pandya akawangaala, nga kaayolebwa ku bbendera za Madurai ez’ebitontome era ne bikubwa ku ssente okumala emyaka egisukka mu lukumi.
A pipeline of terracotta rings, set one: Payipu y’empeta ez’amayinja, eziteekeddwa emu waggulu w’endala mu mitendera ena, eyabikkulwa mu kusima kwa Korkai. Payipu ez’ebbumba ezaakubwa omuliro n’enzizi z’empeta nga zino zaatambuza era ne zifulumya amazzi mu bibuga by’ensi y’ebyafaayo ey’Abatamil eyasooka — ekitundu ku yinginiya wa bulijjo ow’omwalo ogulimu abantu abangi.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiyalur Ur: Ekitontome kya Ten Idylls ekyawandiikibwa Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar, nga kitendereza kabaka w’Abachola Karikal Valavan n’ekibuga kye eky’omwalo ekijjudde abantu ekya Kaveripoompattinam (Puhar), n’emmeeri zaakyo, obutale, n’embaga.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Nakkeerar. D: Ekitontome kya Idylls Ekkumi ekya Nakkeerar. Mu kiseera ky’empewo empanvu ennyo ennyogovu ey’obukiikakkono ey’obutiti, nnaabagereka yeegomba bba nga kabaka alabirira abaserikale be abaalumiziddwa mu nkambi y’olutalo.
A portrait coin of the Chera king Kuttuv: Effeeza ey’ekifaananyi kya kabaka wa Chera Kuttuvan Kotai, ng’amutuuma erinnya mu lulimi Olutamil-Brahmi. Nga balina ssente za Makkotai, ensonga zino eza ffeeza ezitatera kulabika — mpozzi nga ziluŋŋamizibwa ssente z’ebifaananyi by’Abaruumi ezaatuuka nga ziyita mu busuubuzi — ze zimu ku nsimbi z’Abayindi ezaasooka okulaga ffeesi y’omufuzi.
A potsherd inscribed in Tamil-Brahmi, fo: Ekitundu ky’ekiyungu ekyawandiikibwa mu lulimi Olutamil-Brahmi, ekyasangibwa e Tissamaharama mu bugwanjuba bwa Sri Lanka era nga kyawandiikibwa nga ekyasa eky’okubiri B.C.E. Okuwandiika mu lulimi Olutamil ku bibumba ebiri ewala n’olukalu lw’Abatamil kulaga abasuubuzi b’Abatamil nga bakola emitala w’ennyanja mu kiseera ky’ebyafaayo ekyasooka.
A rare book from the first decades of Ta: Ekitabo ekitali kya bulijjo okuva mu myaka egyasooka egy’okukuba ebitabo mu Lutamil, ng’ebiwandiiko eby’edda ebikuumibwa ku bikoola by’enkindu biteekebwa mu kipande omulundi ogwasooka.
A rare volume digitised from CICT’s arch: Omuzingo ogutatera kulabika ogwa digito okuva mu tterekero lya CICT ne gukuumibwa okusoma. Ebikwata ku katalogu mu bujjuvu bijja kwongerwako abakuumi b’ekifo kino.
A Sangam-age Chola coin with a tiger and: Effeeza y’Abachola ey’omulembe gwa Sangam ng’eriko engo n’enjovu. Effeeza z’Abachola ezaasooka, ng’ezisinga za kikomo, zisinga kubeera ku ngo — akabonero ke kamu Abachola ab’obwakabaka ke kaali kagenda okutambuza oluvannyuma lw’emyaka lukumi. Uraiyur ne Kaveripoompattinam ze zaali ebifo byabwe ebinene.
A Sangam-age Pandya coin, typically a sm: Effeeza ya Pandya ey’omulembe gwa Sangam, mu bujjuvu nga ya square entono ey’ekikomo nga ku ludda olumu kuliko enjovu ate ku ludda olulala nga kuliko ekyennyanja ekikoleddwa mu sitayiro. Effeeza ng’ezo zaatambula mu Madurai n’ebitundu ebiriraanyewo, ekibuga ekikulu ekya Pandya ekyakuzibwa mu Maduraikkanchi.
A scholarly study of government, adminis: Okunoonyereza kw’abayivu ku gavumenti, enzirukanya y’emirimu, n’obulamu bw’abantu mu nsi y’Abatamil ey’omulembe gwa Sangam.
A second coin of the Kongu Cheras. Compa: Effeeza eyokubiri eya Kongu Cheras. Geraageranya ebibiri bino: ssente ezikubwa n’engalo zaawukana mu kukuba, okwambala n’okusala, era enjawulo ng’ezo ziyamba abakugu mu by’ensimbi okusunsula ensonga n’okulondoola ebbanga effeeza lye yamala nga zitambula.
A second image of the four-armed, seated: Ekifaananyi ekyokubiri ekya Ganesha ow’emikono ena, ng’atudde. Geraageranya ebipimo byayo, eby’okwewunda n’okukyuka kw’omugogo n’ekisooka: munda mu canon egabanyizibwamu eya Silpa Sastras, buli mubumbe n’omusomo yalekawo okukwata kwe.
A selection drawn from the Thirukkural,: Ebisunsuddwa ebiggiddwa mu Thirukkural, nga bikung’aanya ebigambo ebibiri ebijjukirwanga eri abasomi.
A separate photographing of the opening: Ekifaananyi eky’enjawulo eky’ebikoola ebigguka eby’ekibinja 579 D, ekya Maduraikkanchi.
Omutuukirivu wa Shaiva, emikono nga gigatta mu kusinza. Bakabaka ba Chola baawa ekitiibwa Abanayanmars nkaaga mu basatu, Sekkizhar be yanyumya obulamu bwabwe mu Periya Puranam, era ebifaananyi byabwe eby’ekikomo byateekebwa mu yeekaalu ne bitwalibwa mu kutambula kw’embaga.
A sherd illustrated in Vimala Begley’s 1: Ekitundu ekiragiddwa mu kunoonyereza kwa Vimala Begley mu 1983 ku ngeri Arikamedu gye yaganza. Ng’addamu okwekenneenya layers ezasimibwa, Begley yagamba nti okusenga kwatandika nga mu makkati g’ekyasa eky’okusatu BCE — nga bukyali Mortimer Wheeler bwe yali ateesezza — n’okukwatagana n’ennyanja Meditereniyani ku nkomerero y’ekyasa ekyokubiri BCE. Ennaku ze zikyalina okutaputa kw’abayivu.
A sherd of an urn found in 2004, decorat: Ekitundu ky’ekibbo ekyazuulibwa mu 2004, nga kyayooyooteddwa mu ngeri ya ‘applied relief’ nga kiriko ekifaananyi ky’omukazi ekiyimiridde wakati mu bifaananyi ebitera okusomebwa ng’ebikoola by’emmwanyi, empologoma, crane n’engo. Abamanyi balabye mu ye katonda omukazi maama eyasooka — abamu, nga firimu bw’egamba, omukulembeze wa Kotravai, katonda omukazi ow’olutalo mu bitontome bya Sangam. Ky’ekimu ku bifaananyi eby’akabonero ebitatera kulabika mu Iron Age Tamil Nadu.
A short illustrated guide for visitors:: Ekitabo ekimpi ekirimu ebifaananyi eri abagenyi: ebitontome bya Sangam bye biri, engeri gye bikuŋŋaanyiziddwa mu bibinja, n’engeri ebitontome bya akam ne puram n’ebifo ebitaano gye bikolamu.
A silver kasu of Rajendra Chola combinin: Kasu ya ffeeza eya Rajendra Chola ng’egatta obubonero bw’obwakabaka — engo ya Chola n’ebyennyanja Pandya n’obutaasa bwa Chera. A silver kasu of the “Uttama” type, attr: A silver kasu of the “Uttama” type, attributed here to Rajendra I. Ekika kino kiggya erinnya lyakyo okuva mu ssente za Uttama Chola, nga dizayini yaayo — engo, ebyennyanja n’obutaasa wansi w’akawundo — yateekawo omusono gwa ffeeza ya Chola oluvannyuma.
A simplified sequence of how cloth is ma: Omutendera ogwangu ogw’engeri olugoye gye lukolebwamu. Kinnyonnyola enkola ey’awamu; si bukakafu nti buli musomo gw’Abatamil ogw’edda gwagoberera emitendera gino ddala mu nsengeka eno — ebikozesebwa, n’ensengeka y’okusiiga langi n’okuluka, byali bisobola okwawukana.
A small pottery cup from the Adichanallu: Ekikopo ekitono eky’okubumba okuva mu bifo eby’okuziikamu Adichanallur. Ebikopo, ebbakuli n’ebibikka bye bimu ku bintu ebyasinga okukozesebwa mu ntaana, era enkula zaabyo ez’obwegendereza, ezikwatagana ziraga obukugu bw’ababumbi abaali bakola ku nnamuziga kumpi emyaka enkumi ssatu egiyise.
A summit of Chola architecture, art and: Olukungaana lw’ebizimbe by’Abachola, eby’emikono n’enzirukanya y’emirimu; ekitundu ku Yeekaalu Ennene ez’Abachola Abalamu eza UNESCO.
A temple gopuram over a Madurai street: Gopuram ya yeekaalu waggulu w’oluguudo lw’e Madurai

A village on the Noyyal in Erode distric: Ekyalo ku mugga Noyyal mu disitulikiti y’e Erode, ekyasimibwa ng’ekifo ekikulu eky’okukola obululu, okukola amayinja ag’omuwendo n’okukola ebyuma n’ebyuma.

Agriculture remains an important part of: Ebyobulimi bikyali kitundu kikulu mu by’enfuna bya Tamil Nadu n’obulamu bw’omu byalo. Ebirime ebikulu mulimu omuceere, omuwemba, ppamba, entangawuuzi, ebinyeebwa, n’emmwaanyi, ng’engeri y’okulimamu ekyukakyuka okusinziira ku ttaka, enkuba, okufukirira, n’obwetaavu bw’akatale. Abalimi ab’omulembe guno bakozesa okumanya okw’ennono ne tekinologiya ow’omulembe omuli tulakita, ebyuma ebikungula, ensigo erongooseddwa, ppampu z’okufukirira, n’enkola y’okuddukanya ettaka. Okufukirira mu matondo n’enkola endala ezikekkereza amazzi bisobola okuyamba okuddukanya eby’obugagga by’amazzi eby’ebbula mu nkola z’okulima ezisaanira. Abalimi era boolekagana n’okusoomoozebwa ng’enkuba etali ya bulijjo, ekyeya, okulinnya kw’ebisale by’ebikozesebwa, ebbula ly’abakozi, n’okukyuka kw’ebbeeyi y’akatale. N’olwekyo obusika bw’ebyobulimi mu Tamil Nadu bukiikirira ebyafaayo ebiwanvu eby’okukwatagana n’embeera z’obutonde bw’ensi mu kitundu n’ekitongole ekigenda kikulaakulana nga kyanukula okunyigirizibwa kw’ebyenfuna n’embeera y’obudde okw’omulembe guno.
Agriculture was an important source of f: Ebyobulimi byali nsibuko nkulu ey’emmere, eby’okweyimirizaawo, n’eby’enfuna mu bantu b’omu Tamil ab’edda. Ebiwandiiko bya Sangam, okutwalira awamu ebikwatagana n’ekiseera nga 300 BCE–300 C.E., byogera ku bitundu by’abalimi, ennimiro ezirimibwa, enkuba eyatonnya mu sizoni, obulunzi, n’emirimu gy’ebyobulimi. Abatontomi b’Abatamil baakwataganya ebifo eby’enjawulo n’engeri ez’enjawulo ez’obulamu. Ensi ya Marutham yali ekiikirira ettaka eggimu ery’ebyobulimi, ng’okulima emmwanyi n’emirimu emirala egy’okulima bye bisinga okumanyika. Abalimi baalonda ebirime okusinziira ku mbeera y’ettaka, enkuba, n’amazzi agaliwo. Omuceere, emmwaanyi, omuwemba, ebinyeebwa, ppamba, n’omuwemba bye bimu ku birime ebyogeddwako mu kunoonyereza ku bulimi bw’Abatamil ab’edda. Okulima kwali kwesigamye ku mirimu gy’abantu, amaanyi g’ebisolo, n’okumanya embeera z’obutonde bw’ensi mu kitundu. Obujulizi bw’ebiwandiiko buwa amagezi ag’omuwendo ku bulamu bw’ebyobulimi, wadde nga bulina okutaputibwa wamu n’okunoonyereza ku by’okukuula n’ebyafaayo.

An animated reconstruction of the ancien: Okuddamu okuzimba enkola ey’edda mu ngeri ey’obulamu, okuva mu kiwandiiko ekikwata ku Kallanai ekyakolebwa Central Institute of Classical Tamil. An urn exposed in a trench at Sivakalai,: Ekibbo ekyabikkulwa mu mudumu e Sivakalai, kiromita nga musanvu okuva e Adichanallur okuyita ku Thamirabarani. Ancient and medieval Tamil irrigation sy: Enkola z’okufukirira ez’Abatamil ez’edda n’ez’omu kyasa eky’omu makkati zaakozesanga ebifo eby’okufukirira ebyakolebwa n’obwegendereza okufuga engeri amazzi gye gaava mu ttanka ne gagenda mu mikutu gy’ebyobulimi. Ebizimbe bino tebyali biggule byokka mu bbugwe wa ttanka; dizayini ez’enjawulo zayamba okulungamya entambula y’amazzi n’okusaasaanya amazzi agaterekeddwa mu nnimiro. Ebika bya sluice eby’ennono ebiwerako biwandiikiddwa mu Tamil Nadu, omuli madai, madagu, thumpu ne kumizhi. Dizayini zaabwe entuufu n’emirimu gyazo gyawukana. Ekyokulabirako ekimu ekisinga okunyumira ye nkola ya kumizhi, ekyuma eky’enjawulo ekikwatagana n’okuddukanya amazzi ga ttanka mu ngeri ey’ekinnansi. Sluices zayamba abalimi okufulumya amazzi nga geetaagisa, okusinga okukkiriza ttanka okufuluma nga tezifugibwa, era ne ziwagira okusaasaanya amazzi mu ngeri entegeke nga bayita mu mikutu egiweereza ebitundu by’ebyobulimi eby’enjawulo. Enzimba yazo eraga okumanya okw’omugaso ku puleesa y’amazzi, ekifo we bafulumira, ekisikirize n’enkolagana wakati wa ttanka ezitereka n’ettaka ly’okulimirako. Ebiwandiiko ebikyaliyo bye bimu ku bujulizi obw’omuwendo naddala ku tekinologiya ono ow’okufukirira n’omulimu gw’akola mu kukyusa ebifo eby’ebyobulimi.
Ancient Tamil food habits were shaped by: Emize gy’emmere y’Abatamil ey’edda gyakolebwanga ettaka, embeera y’obudde, omulimu n’ebirungo ebibeerawo mu sizoni. Mu maka, empeke zaakubwanga mu ural ne zisiigibwa ku ammi, ebinyeebwa ne biterekebwa nga nkalu mu bibya eby’ebbumba, era emmere y’omuceere oba emmwaanyi, omuceere n’obutungulu yafumbibwanga mu biyungu eby’ebbumba ne bagigabula ku bikoola by’ebijanjaalo. Ebintu ebiri mu kisenge kino byakolebwa omulimu guno gwennyini.
Ancient Tamil households used objects ma: Amaka g’Abatamil ag’edda gaakozesanga ebintu ebyakolebwa mu bbumba, amayinja, embaawo, ekyuma, ekikomo, ekikomo, ebikoola by’enkindu n’ebintu ebirala eby’obutonde. Bombi bakola olugendo nga bayita mu maka g’ekinnansi ag’Abatamil, nga balaga engeri abantu gye baali babeera n’engeri ebikozesebwa mu maka gaabwe gye byalaga obukugu bwabwe, obutonde n’engeri y’obulamu bwabwe.

Manimegalai by Seethalai Sathanar, one o: Manimegalai eya Seethalai Sathanar, emu ku Epics Ennene Ettaano era nga ye yaddirira Silapathikaram. Kigoberera Manimegalai, muwala wa Kovalan ne Madhavi, mu kkubo lye ery’okufuuka omubiikira Omubuddha.
Many bronzes were made as festival icons: Ebikomo bingi byakolebwanga ng’ebifaananyi eby’embaga (utsava murti), nga bitwalibwa mu nguudo za yeekaalu ku magaali. Ebikondo ebyali ku bituuti byabwe byasobozesanga okuyitamu ebikondo okusobola okubitwala.

Marutham represents fertile agricultural: Marutham ekiikirira ebiwonvu eby’ebyobulimi ebigimu naddala ebitundu ebisaanira okulima omuceere. Okulima kwawagira ebitundu ebyasenga, era okubeerawo kw’ebirime ebirimibwa kyasobozesa okulya emmere ey’enjawulo. Emmere ekwatagana ne Marutham: omuceere, ebinyeebwa, enva endiirwa n’ebimera ebibisi ebya sizoni, omubisi gw’omuwemba ne swiiti, ebyennyanja okuva mu migga n’ebidiba, ennyama okusinziira ku bantu, ebibala, n’omuwemba n’amafuta gaayo. Ekifaananyi ky’emmere eya bulijjo: omuceere ogufumbiddwa nga guweebwa n’ebinyeebwa, enva endiirwa era we guli, ebyennyanja oba ennyama.
Material evidence of urban life that can: Obujulizi obw’ebintu obw’obulamu bw’omu kibuga obuyinza okusomesebwa wamu n’ebiwandiiko bya Sangam.
Mats were woven from materials such as p: Ebitanda byalukibwanga okuva mu bintu ng’ebikoola by’enkindu, emivule n’omuddo. Zaakozesebwanga okutuula, okwebaka, okuwummula n’okukyaza abagenyi. Okusinziira ku bintu n’enkola y’okuluka, emitto gyawukana mu butonde, obunene n’obuwangaazi. Zaali zisobola okuzingibwa ne ziterekebwa nga tezikozesebwa, ekizifuula ez’omugaso mu bulamu obwa bulijjo.
Millets were important grains, particula: Enkwale zaali mpeke nkulu naddala mu bitundu enkuba n’embeera y’ettaka gye byali bisinga okuzirimibwa. Thinai (emmwaanyi y’omukira gw’empeewo), varagu (emmwaanyi ya kodo) ne kambu (emmwaanyi ya luulu) zaali zisobola okufumbibwa ng’empeke, okukolebwamu omuceere oba okutegekebwa mu ngeri endala. Obukulu bwazo bulaga engeri emize gy’emmere gye gyakwataganamu n’embeera z’omu kitundu.
Modern Kanchipuram is widely known as a: Kanchipuram ey’omulembe guno emanyiddwa nnyo ng’ekibuga kya yeekaalu era ekifo ekikulu eky’okuluka silika. Amasinzizo gaayo ag’ebyafaayo gakyagenda mu maaso n’okukola ng’ebifo eby’okusinzizaamu, ate nga saree za silika ez’ekinnansi zigatta ekibuga kino n’obusika bw’ebyemikono obubaddewo okuva edda. Abagenyi basobola okulaba enzimba yaayo ey’eddiini, obutale bw’omu kitundu n’enkola z’obuwangwa obulamu.
Modern Poompuhar is a coastal settlement: Poompuhar ey’omulembe guno kifo ekiri ku lubalama lw’ennyanja mu disitulikiti y’e Mayiladuthurai, Tamil Nadu. Olubalama lw’ennyanja, ebitundu by’omu kitundu, ebitongole by’ebyobuwangwa n’okunoonyereza ku by’edda bikuuma akakwate kaago n’ebyafaayo by’ennyanja eby’edda eby’Abatamil. Enkyukakyuka ku lubalama lw’ennyanja n’okukulugguka kw’ettaka bikosezza ekifo kino, era ensengeka enzijuvu ey’ekibuga eky’edda eky’omwalo temanyiddwa na bukakafu.
Modern Thanjavur remains a major cultura: Thanjavur ey’omulembe guno ekyali kifo ekikulu eky’ebyobuwangwa mu Tamil Nadu. Yeekaalu ya Brihadisvara ekyagenda mu maaso n’okusikiriza abasinza, bannabyafaayo, abakubi b’ebifaananyi n’abalambuzi. Ekibuga kino era kimanyiddwa nnyo olw’ebifaananyi eby’ekika kya Thanjavur, ennyimba za kinnansi, amazina, ebibumbe eby’ekikomo n’emikono egy’ennono.

Mullai represents pastoral and woodland: Mullai akiikirira ebitundu by’obulunzi n’ebibira ebikwatagana n’okulunda ente n’obulamu bw’abalunzi. Amata n’amata byali bya mmere bikulu, ate emmere ey’empeke n’ebirungo ebirala byafunibwa nga bayita mu kulima, okuwanyisiganya n’okukung’aanya mu kitundu. Emmere ekwatagana ne Mullai: amata (paal), curd (thayir), butto (mor), butto (vennai), thinai ne varagu millets, omuceere n’empeke endala ezifunibwa mu kulima oba okuwanyisiganya, ate mu bitundu ebimu ennyama. Ekifaananyi ky’emmere eya bulijjo: emmwaanyi oba omuceere nga guwerekerwako curd oba buttermilk, nga amata n’ebintu ebirala ebiva mu mata ng’emmere enkulu.
Munrurai Araiyanar’s four hundred verses: Ennyiriri za Munrurai Araiyanar ebikumi bina, nga buli emu eggalawo ku lugero.
Nakkeerar’s guide-poem directing a devot: Ekitontome kya Nakkeerar ekilungamya ekilungamya omugoberezi okugenda mu masabo ga Murugan omukaaga, ekyakoppololwa n’okunnyonnyola kwa Nachinarkkiniyar.
Nakkeerar’s poem of the long, cold north: Ekitontome kya Nakkeerar eky’empewo empanvu ennyogovu ey’obukiikakkono: nnaabagereka nga tafunye tulo mu lubiri lwe nga kabaka ali wala mu lutalo.
Naladiyar: 400 four-line verses on ethic: Naladiyar: Ennyiriri 400 ez’ennyiriri nnya ezikwata ku mpisa, mu buwangwa ezigambibwa nti za bamonko b’Abajayina. Kitwalibwa nga kya muwendo nnyo ne kiba nti olugero lw’Olutamil lukigatta n’Oluthirukkural: “Naalum irandum sollukku urudhi.”
Nallathanar’s hundred verses, each namin: Ennyiriri za Nallathanar kikumi, nga buli emu etuuma amannya g’ebintu bisatu ebiwonya ebirowoozo nga entungo enkalu, entungo n’entungo empanvu bwe biwonya omubiri.
Nallur Nathathanar’s guide-poem sending: Nallur Nathathanar’s guide-poem nga esindika bard omwavu eri omulangira Nalliyakkodan. Kopi eno ewandiikiddwa ku lupapula okusinga ku lupapula lw’enkindu.
Named in Sangam poetry as a capital of t: Erinnya mu bitontome bya Sangam ng’ekibuga ekikulu eky’Abachola abaasooka; leero kitundu kya kibuga Tiruchirappalli.
Named in Sangam poetry; excavations at t: Erinnya lyatuumiddwa mu bitontome bya Sangam; okusima mu kifo kino kuzudde ebisigalira by’ebyafaayo eby’edda. Ekiwandiiko ekiraga nti kigerageranye.
Napputhanar’s 103-line poem of a queen w: Napputhanar’s 103-line poem of a queen nga alinze okuyita mu nkuba kabaka we, ewala mu nkambi ye ey’olutalo — esinga obumpi mu Ten Idylls.

Nataraja dances within a circle of flame: Nataraja azina munda mu nkulungo y’ennimi z’omuliro ku ttaka erya bbululu omuzito, ekigere ekimu nga kisimbye ku Apasmara omutono — obutamanya — ekirala nga kisituddwa okubuna omubiri gwe. Waggulu kuwanika kateni n’emikuufu ebisiigiddwa langi; wansi, lingam eyimiridde mu maaso ga bbugwe, nga bwe kiri mu kigo kya Yeekaalu Ennene, ebimuli gye bikyaweebwayo.
Nataraja, the Lord of the Dance, with Si: Nataraja, Mukama w’Amazina, ne Sivakami — Parvati nga mukyala we e Chidambaram, Shiva azina gy’asinzibwa mu kisenge kya zaabu. Mu ngeri ya Tanjore ebifaananyi bino biba bifumbiddwa n’ekisenge ekiyitibwa arch era nga bigaggawalidde mu bikoola bya zaabu n’amayinja agateekeddwamu agayakaayakana mu musana gw’ettaala.
Natrinai, Kurunthokai, Ainkurunuru, Path: Natrinai, Kurunthokai, Ainkurunuru, Pathitrupathu, Paripadal, Kalithokai, Akananuru, ne Purananuru. Ebisinga biba bikuŋŋaanyiziddwa mu bigambo ebimpi, nga bitegekeddwa okusinziira ku buwanvu, omulamwa oba ensonga.
Near Ariyankuppam, south of Puducherry,: Okumpi ne Ariyankuppam, mu bukiikaddyo bwa Puducherry, Arikamedu kye kimu ku bifo ebisinga okumanyika mu kusuubulagana okwasooka okuyita mu nnyanja Buyindi. Okusima kwazuula ebitundutundu by’amayinja aga Mediterranean amphorae, ebintu ebirungi eby’ekika kya Arretine, rouletted ware, obululu n’endabirwamu ku mabbali g’ebibumba eby’omu kitundu — ekifo eky’omu kitundu ekirimu enkolagana ey’ewala, so si ttundutundu lya Rooma. Okuddamu okwekenneenya kwa Vimala Begley mu 1983 kwateeka entandikwa yaayo nga mu makkati g’ekyasa eky’okusatu B.C.E., nga tekunnabaawo okusinga ensengeka y’ebiseera eya Mortimer Wheeler, ng’abantu abaali bakwatagana n’ennyanja Meditereniyani ku nkomerero y’ekyasa ekyokubiri B.C.E.; bino bisigala nga bivvuunulwa by’abayivu.
Near the mouth of the Kaveri, Puhar is r: Okumpi n’omumwa gwa Kaveri, Puhar ejjukirwa ng’ekibuga ekinene eky’omwalo eky’Abachola abaasooka, nga kigatta ennimiro z’omuceere, emikutu gy’amazzi n’obutale bw’omugga Kaveri delta ku Bay of Bengal. Pattinappalai enyonyola omwalo gwayo ogulimu abantu abangi, abasuubuzi n’obutale; aba Silappatikaram ne Manimekalai nabo bakuuma ennono zaayo. Okunoonyereza wansi w’amazzi okukoleddwa ekitongole ky’eby’okukuula eby’edda ekya Tamil Nadu kuzudde amayinja ku lubalama lw’ennyanja Poompuhar, naye obunene bw’ekibuga eky’edda n’ennaku z’ennaku z’ebizimbe byakyo bikyalina okunoonyereza n’obwegendereza — emboozi y’okufiirwa kwakyo mu nnyanja si, ku bwayo, bukakafu bwa katyabaga kamu akaaliwo ennaku.
Near the Tamiraparani in Thoothukudi dis: Okumpi ne Tamiraparani mu disitulikiti ya Thoothukudi, Korkai gwali mwalo gwa Pandya ogw’obuvubi bwa luulu mu Gulf of Mannar — ebyenfuna eby’okubuuka, okuggulawo n’okusunsula oysters, okugabanya luulu n’okuzisuubula. Ekitongole ky’eby’okukuula eby’edda ekya Tamil Nadu kitegeezezza nti okuva olwo ennyanja yazze emabega okuva mu kifo kino; okusima kwazuula ebibumba ebyawandiikibwa mu lulimi Olutamil-Brahmi n’ebisigadde mu bizimbe. Sampuli y’amanda ebadde ewandiikiddwa mu mwaka gwa 785 B.C.E. — olunaku lwa sampuli eyo, si kituufu nti omwalo guno gwe gwatandikibwawo.
Neithal represents coastal regions where: Neithal ekiikirira ebitundu by’oku lubalama lw’ennyanja ng’envuba, okukola omunnyo n’emirimu gy’oku nnyanja byali bikulu. Ebyennyanja n’ebyennyanja ebirala bye byali eby’obugagga ebikulu eby’omu kitundu, era abantu abaali ku lubalama lw’ennyanja baali basuubulagana n’abantu abaali babeera munda mu lukalu olw’emmere ey’empeke n’ebintu ebirala eby’obulimi. Emmere ekwatagana ne Neithal: ebyennyanja ebibisi, ebyennyanja ebikalu (karuvadu), enseenene, enseenene n’ebisusunku, omunnyo okuva mu biyungu by’omunnyo ebiri ku lubalama lw’ennyanja, omuceere nga gulimibwa oba okusuubula, muwogo, n’ebyennyanja ebifumbiddwa n’eby’akaloosa eby’omu kitundu. Ekifaananyi ky’emmere eya bulijjo: ebyennyanja oba ebyennyanja ebikalu ebiweebwa n’omuceere, n’ebyennyanja ebirala n’ebirungo eby’omu kitundu.

Not a land of its own: Kurinji or Mullai: Si nsi yaayo: Kurinji oba Mullai, ekyeya bwe kiba kyokya nga nkalu, mu ttuntu. Katonda waayo omukazi ye Kotravai, ate omuti gwayo ye palai. Omulamwa gwayo gwa pirithal — okwawukana, ng’omuzira asala ettaka ery’amatongo ng’anoonya obugagga oba okuyiga, oba abaagalana ne badduka okulisomoka. Ebitontome byayo bya nguudo nkalu, amazzi matono n’akabi akali mu lugendo.
Not simply a story of a craft disappeari: Si mboozi yokka ey’omulimu gw’emikono ogwabula: emikutu gy’ebyobusuubuzi egy’Abazungu gyakola okugula n’okutunda ebweru w’eggwanga, olugoye lw’amakolero lwaleeta okuvuganya okupya, era ebitundu ebimu eby’okuluka byakyusa ebintu byabwe n’obutale bwabyo ate ebirala ne byolekagana n’obuzibu. Ebikosa byawukana okusinziira ku kitundu, ekiseera, olugoye n’akatale.
On a low gravel mound on the south bank: Ku kifunvu ky’amayinja amatono ku lubalama lw’obugwanjuba bw’omugga Thamirabarani, kiromita nga 24 okuva e Tirunelveli mu disitulikiti y’e Thoothukudi, waliwo ekimu ku bifo ebisinga obunene eby’okuziikamu abantu mu byafaayo eby’edda mu Buyindi, nga kibunye yiika ezisoba mu kikumi. Enkumi n’enkumi z’ebibbo byaziikibwa wano, nga bitera okupakiddwa okumpi, nga bikutte ebisigalira by’abantu nga biriko ebikozesebwa n’ebyokulwanyisa eby’ekyuma, ebibya n’ebibumbe eby’ekikomo, engule eza zaabu, obululu n’ebibumba ebiddugavu n’ebimyufu. Okusima kwatandika mu 1876, nga kye kimu ku byasooka mu by’okukuula eby’edda eby’Abayindi, era kati ennaku za radiocarbon ziteeka okuziika ku ntandikwa y’emyaka lukumi egyasooka B.C.E. Ekifo mwe babeera nga kiriko ekikoomi ky’ababumbi kizuuliddwa okumpi awo: abantu abaaziika abafu baabwe wano nabo baali babeera, nga balima era nga bakola ebyuma ku mabbali gaabwe.
On the Amaravathi river, Karur — remembe: Ku mugga Amaravathi, Karur — ejjukirwa nga Vanchi ne Karuvur — yali kifo ekiri munda mu nsi nga kikwatagana ne bakabaka ba Chera. Ekitongole ky’eby’okukuula eby’edda ekya Tamil Nadu kitegeeza nti ebibumba ebiwandiikiddwa mu lulimi Olutamil-Brahmi, ebitundutundu by’amayinja g’Abaruumi, ebintu ebiyitibwa rouletted ware, ssente z’Abaruumi n’endala, amayinja ag’omuwendo, obululu n’ebizimbe eby’amabaati. Karur yali egalamira ku makubo agayinza okuba nga gaagatta embalama z’amaserengeta n’ebuvanjuba, nga goolekera Muziris ne Arikamedu; ssente zaayo ez’Abaruumi ziraga enkolagana ey’ensimbi, naye tekitegeeza nti zisuubula butereevu ne Rooma.
On the banks of the Thamirabarani in Tho: Ku lubalama lw’omugga Thamirabarani mu disitulikiti y’e Thoothukudi waliwo ekimu ku bifo ebinene eby’okuziikamu abantu mu Buyindi mu mulembe gw’ekyuma. Adichanallur yasooka kusimibwa mu 1876 n’asimibwa Alexander Rea wakati wa 1899 ne 1905, ate n’addamu okusimibwa ekitongole ekinoonyereza ku by’edda ekya Archaeological Survey of India okuva mu 2004, efunye ebibbo ebinene ebikutte ebisigalira by’abantu, nga biteekeddwako ebikozesebwa eby’ekyuma n’ebyokulwanyisa, ebibya eby’ekikomo, eby’okwewunda n’emiguwa egya zaabu. Ebitontome bya Sangam byogera ku bibya ng’ebyo — முதுமக்கள் தாழி — era ne byogera n’omubumbi eyabikola: கலம்செய் கோவே, “O kabaka mu ababumbi”.
On the Malabar coast of present-day Kera: Ku lubalama lw’ennyanja Malabar mu Kerala leero, Muziris gwali mwalo munene ogw’obusuubuzi obw’omu nnyanja Buyindi ogwasooka, nga gumanyiddwa nnyo olw’entungo naye nga gusuubula nnyo: ebiva mu bibira n’eby’oku faamu okuva mu bitundu eby’omunda, ebibya ebiyingizibwa mu ggwanga n’ebibumba ebirungi, n’ebyamaguzi ebyayisibwa abasuubuzi mu bitundu bingi. Periplus y’ennyanja Erythraean egiteeka mu mutimbagano gw’emyalo egyegatta ku nnyanja Emmyufu, Misiri ne Mediterranean. Ekifo kyayo ekituufu kikubaganyizibwako ebirowoozo: okusima e Pattanam kuzudde ebibumba ebiyingizibwa mu ggwanga n’ebibya eby’entambula, era Pattanam eyinza okuba ekitundu ku Muziris ez’edda — endowooza y’abayivu, so si nsonga etegeerekeka.
One of Kanchipuram’s temple gateways ris: Omu ku miryango gya yeekaalu ya Kanchipuram nga gusituka ku luguudo olujjudde abantu — ekibuga kya yeekaalu ng’ekifo ekiramu eky’okusinzizaamu.
One of the Eight Anthologies: 150 love p: Ekimu ku Bitontome Omunaana: Ebitontome by’omukwano 150 mu mita ya kali erimu obulamu. Bingi biwandiikibwa ng’emboozi ez’akazannyo wakati w’abaagalana ne mikwano gyabwe.
One of the Eight Anthologies: 400 “outer: Ekimu ku bitabo Omunaana Ebikuŋŋaanyiziddwa: Ebitontome “ensi ey’ebweru” (puram) 400 ebikwata ku bakabaka, entalo, obugabi, n’empisa. Mulimu layini emanyiddwa ennyo “Yaadhum oore yaavarum kelir” — buli kibuga kibuga kyaffe, buli muntu ab’oluganda lwaffe.
One of the Eight Anthologies: 400 longer: Ekimu ku Bitontome Omunaana: Ebitontome ebiwanvu eby’omukwano (akam) 400 eby’ennyiriri 13 ku 31. Ng’oggyeeko okwagala, ebitontome bikuuma ebintu eby’omuwendo ebikwata ku byafaayo, bakabaka, n’obulamu obwa bulijjo.
One of the Eight Anthologies: 400 love (: Ekimu ku Bitontome Omunaana: Ebitontome by’omukwano (akam) 400 nga buli kimu kirimu ennyiriri 9 ku 12, ebyawandiikibwa abayimbi bangi. Ebitontome bikwata ebiseera by’omukwano ebiteekeddwa mu bifo ebitaano eby’Abatamil.
One of the Eight Anthologies: 500 very s: Ekimu ku bitabo omunaana ebikuŋŋaanyiziddwa: ebitontome by’omukwano ebimpi ennyo 500, ekikumi ku buli kimu ku bifo ebitaano ebirabika obulungi, buli kikumi kyayiiya omutontomi ow’enjawulo.
One of the Eight Anthologies: about 400: Ekimu ku bitabo omunaana ebikuŋŋaanyiziddwa: ebitontome by’omukwano ebimpi nga 400 eby’ennyiriri 4 ku 8. Ebifaananyi byayo ebikwatagana, ebirabika obulungi — nga “okwagala okugazi okusinga ensi” — bigifuula emu ku nkuŋŋaanya za Sangam ezisinga okwagalibwa.
One of the Eight Anthologies: musical hy: Ekimu ku bitabo omunaana ebikuŋŋaanyiziddwa: ennyimba z’omuziki eri Thirumal (Vishnu) ne Murugan n’ennyimba ezikwata ku mugga Vaigai ne Madurai. Ku bitontome nsanvu ebyasooka, nga amakumi abiri mu bina byokka bye bisigaddewo.
One of the Eight Anthologies: ten decade: Ekimu ku bitabo omunaana ebikuŋŋaanyiziddwa: ebitontome eby’emyaka kkumi, nga buli kimu kyawandiikibwa omutontomi ow’enjawulo, nga kitendereza bakabaka b’olulyo lwa Chera. Emyaka egyasooka n’egyasembayo gifiiriddwa.
One of the Eighteen Minor Classics (Path: Ekimu ku bitabo ebitono ekkumi n’omunaana eby’edda (Pathinenkilkanakku), ebya Muvathiyar: ebitontome by’omukwano nsanvu, kkumi na bina ku buli kimu ku bifo ebitaano ebirabika obulungi.
One of the Eighteen Minor Classics, by K: Emu ku Eighteen Minor Classics, eya Kanimethaviyar: ebitontome by’omukwano nga kikumi mu ataano, ebimu amakumi asatu ku buli kimu ku bifo ebitaano ebirabika obulungi.

One of the most prolific Sangam poets, m: Omu ku bayimbi abasinga okukola ennyo mu Sangam, omukugu mu kurinji (ensozi) landscape era omuwandiisi wa Kurinjippattu. Omukwano gwe ne Vel Pari gwe gumu ku gusinga okujjukirwa mu biwandiiko by’Olutamil; oluvannyuma lw’okufa kwa Pari, ennono egamba nti yalabirira bawala ba Pari.
One of the surviving halls, with its arc: Ekimu ku bisenge ebikyaliyo, nga kiriko ebisenge byakyo ebiyitibwa arcades nga biriko empagi empanvu.

Enzikiriza ya Buddha yakulaakulana mu Nagapattinam mu kiseera ky’Abachola, Rajaraja I gye yawa kabaka wa Srivijaya ekigo, era ebikumi n’ebikumi by’ebikomo by’Ababuddha byasuulibwa mu ngeri y’Abachola.
The cabinets in this wing hold CICT edit: Kabineti eziri mu kiwawaatiro kino zirimu ebitabo bya CICT ebya Ten Idylls ne Eight Anthologies. Ggulawo oluggi lw’endabirwamu, londa omuzingo, era okyuse empapula zaayo mu musomi. Buli muzingo era osobola okuguwanula okusoma.
The capital Rajendra I founded to commem: Ekibuga ekikulu Rajendra I kye yatandikawo okujjukira kampeyini ze mu bukiikakkono; yeekaalu yaayo ennene eya Shiva esigaddewo, ekitundu ekisinga obunene mu kibuga tekikyaliwo.
The cave inscriptions at Mangulam near M: Ebiwandiiko by’empuku e Mangulam okumpi ne Madurai bye bimu ku biwandiiko by’Olutamil-Brahmi ebisinga obukadde. Boogera ku mufuzi w’e Pandya Nedunchezhiyan n’ebirabo ebyaweebwa abamonko.
The celebrated early Chola king of Patti: Kabaka w’Abachola abaasooka owa Pattinappalai ne Porunaratruppadai eyali amanyiddwa ennyo, eyawangudde olutalo lw’e Venni mu biwandiiko. Ennono emugamba nti ye yava Kallanai, ekidiba eky’edda eky’okuwugulaza emitala wa Kaveri ekyafukiriranga omugga guno; ekizimbe kino kibadde kiddaabirizibwa era ne kikyusibwa okumala ebyasa bingi.
The Chera capital of Sangam poetry and S: Ekibuga ekikulu ekya Chera eky’ebitontome bya Sangam ne Silappathikaram. We kyayimiridde kikaayanirwa: bannabyafaayo bangi bakikwataganya ne Karur mu Tamil Nadu, abalala ne Thiruvanchikulam okumpi ne Kodungallur mu Kerala. The Chera, Chola, and Pandya dynasties e: Obufuzi bwa Chera, Chola, ne Pandya buli omu yafulumya ssente eziriko obubonero bwazo obw’obwakabaka: obutaasa (Chera), engo (Chola), n’ebyennyanja (Pandya). The cultivated fields and river plains,: Ennimiro ezirimibwa n’ebiwonvu by’emigga, ku makya mu buli sizoni. Katonda waayo ye Vendhan (Indra), ate omuti gwayo ye marutham. Omulamwa gwayo gwe oodal, okuyomba okuwuuma kw’omukyala n’omwami akyamye. Abantu baayo balimi b’ettaka ly’emmwanyi eggagga, ensibuko y’obugagga bwa bakabaka.
The earliest known Tamil writing, carved: Ebiwandiiko by’Olutamil ebyasooka okumanyibwa, ebyayolwa mu mpuku era nga bikubiddwa ku bibumba, okuva mu Mangulam, Jambai, Pugalur, ne Keezhadi.
The earliest Tamil dynastic coins, from: Effeeza ez’olulyo lw’Abatamil ezaasooka, okuva mu byasa eby’emabega B.C.E., zisinga kuba butundutundu butono obwa square oba obwekulungirivu obw’ekikomo n’omusulo. Effeeza za Pandya zigatta enjovu n’ekyennyanja ekikoleddwa mu sitayiro; Effeeza za Chola ziraga engo, ng’emirundi mingi erina enjovu oba embalaasi; Effeeza za Chera zirina obutaasa n’obusaale. Abamu batuuma amannya g’abazifulumya mu lulimi Olutamil-Brahmi, gamba ng’ensimbi za Pandya ezisoma பெருவழுதி (Peruvazhuthi) n’ensimbi eza ffeeza ez’ekifaananyi kya bakabaka ba Chera Makkotai ne Kuttuvan Kotai. Bangi bazuuliddwa mu kitanda ky’omugga Amaravathi e Karur, ekifo eky’edda ekya Chera.
The early Pandya port near the mouth of: Omwalo gw’e Pandya ogwasooka okumpi n’omugga Thamirabarani we gufulumira, ogwamanyika olw’okuvuba luulu. Okuva olwo ennyanja yagenda ekendeera, ekyalo ne kireka munda mu lukalu.
The eight-armed goddess, her face painte: Katonda omukazi ow’emikono munaana, mu maaso ge nga gasiigiddwa langi ya bbululu, ayimiridde waggulu w’omutwe gw’omusambwa gw’enyanja Mahisha, ng’akutte ekitala, obutaasa, obusaale, discus n’engabo, ate abakazi babiri bamugendako nga bakuba enseenene. Mu nnono y’Abatamil akwatagana ne Korravai, katonda omukazi ow’olutalo eyawangudde mu bitontome bya Sangam.
The eri system was a major part of tradi: Enkola ya eri yali kitundu kinene mu kuddukanya amazzi mu ngeri ey’ekinnansi mu Tamil Nadu. Eri ttanka y’okufukirira ey’ekikugu ekoleddwa okukung’aanya n’okutereka amazzi g’enkuba n’amazzi agakulukuta okuva waggulu. Mu kiseera ky’omusana, amazzi gaakuŋŋaanyizibwa emabega w’olukomera olw’ebbumba. Olwo yali esobola okufulumizibwa okulima ng’enkuba ekendedde. Ttanka zino zaali za muwendo nnyo naddala mu bitundu ebitaliiko migga egy’olubeerera egy’okutuuka mu ngeri eyesigika. Amazzi agaterekeddwa gaali gayamba okulima emmwanyi n’ebirime ebirala, ate ebitanda bya ttanka n’ettaka eryetooloddewo byali bikola ekitundu ku by’obulimi ku kyalo. Mu bitundu ebimu, ttanka zaategekebwa mu nsengeka ezikwatagana: okukulukuta okuva mu ttanka eya waggulu kwali kusobola okugenda mu ttanka eya wansi, ne kiyamba ebitundu okukozesa enkuba eya sizoni mu kitundu ekigazi. Eri yali esingako ku kizimbe ekitereka amazzi. Yali kitundu ku nkola y’ebyalo egazi nga yeetaaga okuggyamu omuddo buli kiseera, okuddaabiriza n’okuddukanya awamu. Ttanka bwe zaddaabirizibwa obulungi, zayamba okukendeeza ku kufiirwa kw’amazzi nga ziyita mu kukulukuta okutafugibwa era ne zilongoosa amazzi mu biseera eby’ekyeya.
The fertile Kaveri valley and delta, hea: Ekiwonvu kya Kaveri ekigimu ne delta, omutima gw’ensi y’Abachola. Akabonero kayimiridde ku Kallanai, ekidiba eky’edda eky’okuwugula emitala w’omugga; ekitundu kyennyini kibunye mu kitundu ekiyitibwa delta.
The first of the Ten Idylls (Pattuppattu: Esooka ku Idylls Ekkumi (Pattuppattu), eyayimbibwa Nakkeerar. Mu “kitontome kino ekilungamya” omugoberezi eyaweebwa omukisa Mukama Murugan alungamya omunoonya omulala gy’ali, ng’annyonnyola ebifo bye omukaaga ebitukuvu, Arupadai Veedu.

The foods that travelled with Tamil trad: Emmere eyatambula n’obusuubuzi bw’Abatamil — entungo enjeru, entungo ne entungo zanoonyezebwa emitala w’ennyanja Buyindi, amafuta g’omuwemba, enkindu n’omubisi gw’enjuki, n’omuceere abantu b’oku lubalama lw’ennyanja gwe baatwala nga bawaanyisiganya ebyennyanja n’omunnyo.
The four families of Tamil instruments:: Amaka ana ag’ebivuga by’Olutamil: okwekweka — murasu ey’obwakabaka, parai, thavil, udukkai ne pambai; omukka — nadaswaram n’entongooli ey’emiwemba; emiguwa — yazh ya Sangam bards ne veenai; n’ekyuma — eky’ekika kya thalam.
The Gangaikondacholeeswaram Temple and i: Yeekaalu ya Gangaikondacholeeswaram n'ekizimbe kyayo leero, ng'olaba okuva mu bbanga.
The Grand Anicut at work: water rushing: Grand Anicut ng’ekola: amazzi nga gafubutuka okuyita mu mifulejje gyayo, waggulu w’omukutu gwayo ogukulukuta ne gagenda mu mikutu gy’omugga. Akatambi okuva mu kiwandiiko ekikwata ku Kallanai ekyakolebwa ekitongole kya Central Institute of Classical Tamil.
The great courtyard seen through the pal: Oluggya olunene olulabibwa okuyita mu mpagi ennene n’ebisenge by’olubiri.
The heroine of Silappathikaram, who prov: Omuzira wa Silappathikaram, eyakakasa nti bba Kovalan talina musango mu maaso ga kabaka wa Pandya bwe yamenya enkizi ye: eyiye yakutte amalusu, luulu za nnaabagereka. Omuwandiisi w’ebiwandiiko okusinga omuntu ow’ebyafaayo eyawandiikibwa, yafuuka akabonero k’obwenkanya — era asinzibwa nga Pattini ne Kannaki Amman mu Tamil Nadu, Kerala ne Sri Lanka.
The image of Shiva as Nataraja, Lord of: Ekifaananyi kya Shiva nga Nataraja, Mukama w’Amazina, ng’azina mu mpeta y’ennimi z’omuliro, kye kifaananyi ky’ekikomo kya Chola ekisinga okukuzibwa. Kiraga enzirukanya y’omu bwengula ey’okutonda, okukuuma, n’okusaanuuka.
The Jambai inscription in Villupuram dis: Ekiwandiiko kya Jambai mu disitulikiti y’e Villupuram kituuma amannya “Satiyaputo Atiyan Netuman Anci”, nga kigatta abaami b’Abaatiyaman ku Satiyaputa aboogerwako mu biragiro bya Ashoka.

The Kailasanatha Temple, a Pallava-perio: Yeekaalu ya Kailasanatha, yeekaalu ey’amayinja ey’omu kiseera kya Pallava, ng’erina obusabo obutonotono obuli mu layini y’olukomera lwayo.
The kalayam, the everyday Tamil clay pot: The kalayam, ekiyungu ky’ebbumba eky’Abatamil ekya bulijjo. Omubiri gwayo ogwetooloovu n’ensingo enfunda bikuuma amazzi nga mayonjo era nga gangu okutambuza, era kalayams zikyasuulibwa ku nnamuziga y’omubumbi ne zikubwa mu bikoomi by’ebyalo — akakwate akalamu ku bibya ebyasimibwa mu bifo by’Abatamil.
The Kallanai, or Grand Anicut, across th: Kallanai, oba Grand Anicut, emitala wa Kaveri — mu buwangwa nga kigambibwa nti yava ku kabaka w’Abachola Karikala — yazimbibwa okulung’amya n’okukyusa amazzi g’omugga guno mu mikutu okufukirira. Yafuula Kaveri delta emu ku ttaka eddene eririmibwa omuceere mu Tamil Nadu, era n’okutuusa kati n’okutuusa kati eweereza enkola yaayo ey’okufukirira. (Laba ekisenge ky’okufukirira okumanya ebisingawo ku yinginiya w’amazzi mu Tamil.)
The Kanchipuram silk saree is one of the: Kanchipuram silk saree y’emu ku ngoye z’ekinnansi ezisinga okukuzibwa mu Tamil Nadu. Saree eno esibuka mu Kanchipuram, ekifo eky’ebyafaayo eky’okuluka engoye, emanyiddwa nnyo olw’olugoye lwayo olwa silika olulungi, omulimu gwa zari oguzibu, ensalosalo ez’enjawulo, n’emisono egy’enjawulo. Ebifaananyi eby’ennono mulimu eminaala gya yeekaalu, enkookooma, emiyembe, ebimuli, n’ebifaananyi ebya geometry. Saree eno elukibwa nga bakozesa wuzi ya silika, ng’eriko obuwuzi bwa zari obwa langi ya zaabu oba ffeeza nga bongera ku bugagga obw’okuyooyoota. Kanchipuram silk sarees zirina ekifo ekikulu mu mbaga z’Abatamil, emikolo gy’eddiini, embaga, n’emikolo emirala egy’enjawulo. Enkola y’okuluka yeetaaga obukugu bungi naddala nga bagatta omubiri, ensalosalo, ne pallu nga bakozesa obukodyo obw’ekinnansi obw’okuyunga. Omulimu guno gwakulaakulana okumala emirembe, era omwaka gwennyini gwe gwatandikibwawo tegumanyiddwa mu byafaayo. Kancheepuram Silk yafuna okusiimibwa mu ngeri ya Geographical Indication (GI) mu 2005. Leero, saree eno ekiikirira obusika bw’eby’okwambala mu Tamil Nadu, obukugu obw’emikono, n’embeera z’abantu abaluka engoye ez’ennono ezigenda mu maaso.
The Kandangi saree is a traditional cott: Kandangi saree lugoye lwa ppamba olw’ekinnansi olukwatagana n’ekitundu kya Chettinad naddala Karaikudi n’ebitundu ebiriraanyewo. Kimanyiddwa olw’okubeera ne kkeeki enzirugavu, emisono, ensalosalo ezitali zimu, ne langi ez’amaanyi omuli emmyufu, mukene, emicungwa ne kitaka ow’ettaka. Mu buwangwa, olugoye lwayo olwa ppamba olugumu lwali lusaanira okukozesebwa bulijjo, nga lulaga ebyetaago eby’omugaso eby’engoye eza bulijjo. Okuluka Kandangi kukiikirira okumanya okw’enjawulo mu by’obulungi n’eby’okwambala mu kitundu kya Chettinad. Emisono gyayo n’okugatta langi zaayo bigyawula ku nnono endala nnyingi eza saree eza South Buyindi. Enkola y’okugikola erimu okuteekateeka obuwuzi, okusengeka obuwuzi ku lugoye, okuluka olugoye, n’okumaliriza ensalosalo n’okumaliriza. Ebintu bya gavumenti ebikola engoye z’emikono byogera ku nnono eno ng’ebaddewo okumala emyaka egisukka mu 150, wadde ng’omwaka omutuufu gwe yatandikira tegunnakakasibwa. Kandangi sarees zafuna okusiimibwa okuva mu GI mu 2019, ne ziyamba okuzuula n’okukuuma obutonde bwazo obw’ekitundu n’emirimu gy’emikono egy’ennono.

The Kaveri in spate below the Grand Anic: Aba Kaveri mu bbanga wansi w’omugga Grand Anicut. Abawandiisi b’ebitontome Abatamil baatendereza ensi y’Abachola ng’ensi y’Abakaveri, ng’obugabi bwabwe tebulemererwa; aba Silappatikaram bagikuza ng’ensi y’emmwanyi ezitaliiko kkomo. Anicut yafuula bounty eyo enkola eddukanyizibwa, era delta yafuuka ebbakuli y’omuceere mu nsi y’Abatamil.
The Kaveri rushing through the vents: Aba Kaveri nga bafubutuka nga bayita mu mikutu gy’empewo
The Koorainadu saree is associated with: Koorainadu saree ekwatagana ne Koorainadu okumpi ne Mayiladuthurai mu Tamil Nadu. Kikwatagana nnyo n’ennyambala y’embaga ey’ekinnansi n’amakulu g’ebyobuwangwa ag’engoye mu mpisa z’obufumbo bw’Abatamil. Ebika by’ekinnansi mulimu emifaliso gya silika ne silika-ppamba, nga giriko dizayini n’ebintu eby’enjawulo ebikozesebwa okusinziira ku sitayiro n’ekigendererwa. Saree eno eraga omulimu gw’engoye ezilukibwa mu mikolo emikulu egy’amaka n’okutambuza ennono z’engoye wakati w’emilembe. Endabika yaayo, olugoye, n’ebintu eby’okuyooyoota bisobola okwawukana, n’olwekyo ebyokulabirako ssekinnoomu birina okuwandiikibwa okusinziira ku nzimba yaabyo entuufu okusinga okulowooza nti buli saree ya Koorainadu egoberera dizayini y’emu. Omwaka omutuufu ogw’ensibuko y’ennono eno tegunywevu. Koorainadu sarees zisigala nga nsonga ya muwendo okunoonyereza ku nkolagana wakati w’engoye, endagamuntu y’ekitundu, emirimu gy’emikono, n’obulamu bw’emikolo mu Tamil Nadu.
The Kovai Kora cotton saree is associate: Kovai Kora cotton saree ekwatagana ne Coimbatore n’ekitundu ekikyetoolodde ekikola engoye. Ekoleddwa mu ppamba, esiimibwa olw’obulungi bwayo obutali bwa kitiibwa, obutonde bwayo obunyuma, n’ensalosalo zaayo ez’ekinnansi. Bw’ogeraageranya ne saree za silika eziyooyooteddwa ennyo, engoye za ppamba eza Kora zitera okuggumiza endabika ya ppamba ey’obutonde, okwambala mu ngeri ey’omugaso, n’ebintu ebitonotono ebikwata ku dizayini. Saree eno eraga obukulu bw’okulima ppamba, okukola obuwuzi, okuluka, n’obusuubuzi bw’engoye mu Tamil Nadu. Okukola saree y’okuluka engoye mu ngalo kyetaagisa okuteekateeka n’obwegendereza obuwuzi bwa warp ne weft n’okuddukanya engoye mu ngeri ey’obukugu. Ppamba wa Kora asaanira ku mikolo egy’enjawulo omuli okwambala buli lunaku n’enkuŋŋaana entongole. Kovai Kora Cotton yafuna okusiimibwa okuva mu GI mu 2008. Omwaka gwennyini gwe yatandikibwawo tegunnateekebwawo, naye ennono eno ekyali kyakulabirako kikulu eky’obusika bw’eggwanga obw’enjawulo obw’okuluka ppamba.
The larger digitisation catalogued under: Enkola ennene eya digito ewandiikiddwa wansi w’ennamba y’emu, 603 D: ebifaananyi by’amakoola ebisukka mu bikumi mukaaga eby’ekibinja Kar Narpathu mw’ekuumibwa.
The Leiden plates record a Chola grant o: Ebipande bya Leiden biwandiika ensimbi z’Abachola ez’ekyalo eri vihara y’Ababuddha e Nagapattinam, eyalagirwa Rajaraja I era n’efulumizibwa wansi wa Rajendra I. Kati zikuumibwa mu Leiden, mu Budaaki.
The literary image of ancient Tamil mari: Ekifaananyi ky’ebiwandiiko eky’okukulaakulana kw’ennyanja mu Tamil ey’edda.
The long pillared cloister that encloses: Ekigo ekiwanvu eky’empagi ekizing’amya oluggya lwa yeekaalu ya Brihadisvara, nga kuliko olunyiriri lwa lingam eziteekeddwa wansi waakyo. Ebisenge byayo byasiigibwa langi mu kiseera kya Nayak nga biriko ebifaananyi ebiramu — wano Shiva’s pot-bellied ganas, his playful dwarf attendants — wansi w’ekibinja ky’ebigambo by’Olutamil. Emabega w’ebifaananyi ng’ebyo eby’oluvannyuma, mu kkubo eryetoolodde ekifo ekitukuvu, mulimu ebifaananyi bya yeekaalu eby’olubereberye eby’Abachola.
The longest of the Ten Idylls, by Mangud: Ekisinga obuwanvu ku Idylls Ekkumi, ekyawandiikibwa Mangudi Maruthanar, nga kyayogerwako eri kabaka wa Pandya Nedunchezhiyan. Kinnyonnyola ekibuga ekinene ekya Madurai okuva ku makya okutuuka ekiro era kijjukiza mpola kabaka nti ekitiibwa kyonna eky’ensi kiyitawo.
The lotus pool of Sittanavasal, the Pall: Ekidiba kya lotus ekya Sittanavasal, katonda omukazi Pallava ow’e Panamalai, ebifaananyi by’Abachola ku bbugwe n’ebifaananyi eby’oku bbugwe eby’Abanayak ebya Yeekaalu Ennene e Thanjavur, n’ebifaananyi eby’e Tanjore ebya zaabu.
The Madurai Sungudi saree is a tradition: Madurai Sungudi saree lugoye lwa ppamba olw’ekinnansi olukwatagana ne Madurai, ekifo eky’ebyafaayo eky’ebyobuwangwa n’ebyobusuubuzi mu Tamil Nadu. Yawulwamu olw’emisono gyayo egy’ennyiriri, dizayini zaayo eza langi, n’obukodyo obw’ennono obw’okusiba langi oba okuziyiza okusiiga langi. Ebitundu ebitonotono eby’olugoye bisibibwa oba okukuumibwa nga basiiga langi okusobola okukola emisono egy’enjawulo ng’ekintu ekyo kibikkuddwa. Engoye za Sungudi zitwalibwa nga za muwendo olw’endabika yazo ezisikiriza, olugoye lwa ppamba olutazitowa, n’okusaanira engoye eza bulijjo n’ez’ennaku enkulu. Omulimu guno gugatta okumanya okuteekateeka olugoye, obukodyo bw’okusiba, okusiiga langi n’okumaliriza. Ensibuko yaayo ey’ebyafaayo tesibiddwa ku mwaka gumu ogw’okutandika oguwandiikiddwa obulungi. Madurai Sungudi yafuna okusiimibwa okuva mu GI mu 2005, ng’esiima enkolagana yaayo n’ekitundu kino. Ennono eno eraga engeri abakozi b’emikono egy’Abatamil gye baakola dizayini z’engoye ez’enjawulo nga bakozesa obukugu obw’enjawulo mu kusiiga langi n’enkola z’okufulumya ezaateekebwawo mu kitundu.
The masonry arches that now crown the an: Ebisenge eby’amayinja kati ebiwanirira ekigo eky’edda engule. Bayinginiya b’e Bungereza abaasoma Kallanai mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omwenda baagikwatibwako nnyo: Sir Arthur Cotton yayigira ku misingi gyayo nga tannazimba Upper Anicut okusomoka Kollidam mu 1836, era Richard Baird Smith yagitendereza mu myaka gya 1850 ng’omulimu ogw’ekitalo ogwamala ebyasa bingi. Bano be baagituuma erinnya “Grand Anicut”.
The Meenakshi Amman Temple, historic str: Yeekaalu ya Meenakshi Amman, enguudo ez’ebyafaayo, ennono z’eddiini, n’enkola z’ebiwandiiko n’obuwangwa ezigenda mu maaso bikwataganya Madurai ey’omulembe guno n’ebyafaayo byayo ebiwanvu.
The memorial hall to Karikal Chozhan at: Ekisenge ky’ekijjukizo kya Karikal Chozhan e Kallanai, ekyasituddwa Gavumenti ya Tamil Nadu. Karikalan, omuzira w’Abapattinappalai ne Porunarruppadai, ajjukirwa mu nnono y’Abatamil nga kabaka eyafuga Kaveri. The mini-map in the corner shows the who: Maapu entonotono eri mu nsonda eraga myuziyamu yonna; akasaale akamyufu gwe ggwe, ng’osonga ekkubo ly’otunudde. Ggulawo maapu enzijuvu (oba bbaatuuni ya Maapu) era olonde ekisenge oba ekisenge kyonna ky’ogenda okutambulirayo.

The nadaswaram is the great double-reed: Nadaswaram kye kivuga ekinene eky’empewo eky’emivule ebiri eky’omuziki gwa yeekaalu y’Abatamil, nga kiwulikika ku mbaga, embaga n’okukuŋŋaana. Omubiri omuwanvu ogw’embaawo oguliko ebituli by’engalo gukoma mu kagombe akakutte; omuvule n’ekikuta biwa eddoboozi lyagwo ery’amaanyi, ery’okutwala. Nga yeetaaga okufuga omukka n’okukuba enduulu ennungi, ekuba improvisations empanvu eza classical, ragas ne compositions — ebiseera ebisinga mu nkolagana ne thavil.
The name seems to have been borne by mor: Erinnya lino lirabika nga lyasitulibwa abayimbi abakyala abasukka mu omu. Ebitontome bya Sangam Avvaiyar mu Purananuru, Akananuru, Kurunthogai ne Natrinai byogera ku bakabaka, obugabi n’okufa; yali muwabuzi wa Adhiyaman eyeesigika. Ennyimba z’abaana eza kalasi Aathichudi, Kondrai Vendhan ne Nalvazhi za Avvaiyar eyaddako.
The Noyyal River region of Tamil Nadu pr: Ekitundu ky’omugga Noyyal mu Tamil Nadu kiwa ekyokulabirako ekirala eky’okuddukanya amazzi nga tuyita mu mutimbagano gwa ttanka n’emikutu egyekuusa ku nsonga eno. Mu kifo ky’okwesigamira ku kutambula kw’omugga obutereevu kwokka, ebitundu byakola enkola z’okutereka amazzi ezaayamba okukwata n’okusaasaanya amazzi agaliwo. Ttanka eziri mu mitimbagano ng’ezo zaali zisobola okukung’aanya enkuba n’amazzi agakulukuta mu sizoni, ne zibitereka okusobola okukozesebwa mu bulimi oluvannyuma. Omugaso gwazo gwasinziira ku nteekateeka y’ekifo, embeera y’ebigo, obusobozi bw’emikutu n’ekiseera enkuba we yatonnya. Bwe yakuumibwa obulungi, omukutu oguyungiddwa gwayamba okubunyisa eby’obugagga by’amazzi ebitono mu bifo ebiwerako. Enkola y’omugga Noyyal nayo emanyiddwa mu biwandiiko bya Buyindi ebikwata ku busika bw’amazzi. Kiraga lwaki okufukirira okw’ekinnansi kulina okutegeerwa ng’omukutu gw’ebizimbe ebikwatagana okusinga okukung’aanya ttanka ezeetongodde.
The objects of a Tamil home, the Kallana: Ebintu by’amaka g’Abatamil, ttanka z’Abakalanai ne ku kyalo, n’okulima okuva ku nnima okutuuka ku makungula.
The objects of a traditional Tamil home: Ebintu eby’omu maka g’Abatamil ag’ekinnansi — ebiyungu eby’ebbumba n’ebibya eby’empeke, amayinja agasena ammi ne aattukkal, ural ne ulakkai, ebiyungu by’amazzi, amataala g’amafuta, emitanda, abawagizi, obutanda, ebisero n’ebiso — n’emmere eya bulijjo efumbibwa nabyo: omuceere n’emmwaanyi, ebinyeebwa, koozh, butto n’emmere ku kikoola ky’ebijanjaalo.
The oldest surviving Tamil grammar, in t: Grammer y’Olutamil esinga obukadde, mu bitabo bisatu — eby’ennukuta, eby’ebigambo, n’eby’ensonga (porul), nga eno tinai ttaano ez’ebitontome ziteekeddwawo.
The Painted Cloister of the Big Temple: Ekigo Ekisiigiddwa langi ekya Yeekaalu Ennene
The palace hall in an early engraving: Ekisenge ky’olubiri mu kifaananyi ekikubiddwa nga bukyali
The Pallava capital and a temple city of: Ekibuga ekikulu ekya Pallava era ekibuga kya yeekaalu eky’okuyiga, ekikyali ekifo eky’okusinzizaamu n’okuluka silika.
The palmyra palm provided several useful: Enkindu ya palmyra yawa ebintu ebiwerako eby’omugaso. Omubisi gw’enkindu gwali gusobola okuliibwa nga mupya oba nga gulongooseddwa, ate ssukaali w’enkindu ne jaggery y’enkindu byakozesebwanga ng’ebiwoomerera. Ebintu ebiva mu nkindu byali bya muwendo nnyo naddala mu bitundu omuti mwe gwali omungi era nga gukola ekitundu ku bulamu bw’abantu b’omu kitundu.
The pambai is a pair of drums played tog: Pambai ye ngoma bbiri ezikubiddwa wamu, amaloboozi gazo aga wansi n’aga waggulu agawukana nga gavuga ebivvulu by’abantu, okukuŋŋaana n’embaga z’oku byalo okwetoloola Tamil Nadu. Ennono yaayo ennamu ewandiikiddwa bulungi okusinga ensibuko yaayo, era ensengeka yaayo ekyukakyuka okuva mu kitundu okudda mu kirala n’ekitundu okudda mu kirala.
The Pancha Rathas are monolithic shrines: Pancha Rathas masabo agalimu amayinja agamu buli limu nga gayooleddwa okuva mu kifo kimu, nga galaga ebifaananyi eby’enjawulo eby’ebizimbe bya yeekaalu mu mayinja.
The Pandya capital on the Vaigai, closel: Ekibuga ekikulu ekya Pandya ku Vaigai, ekikwatagana ennyo n’ennono z’Abatamil Sangam n’ebitontome eby’edda.

The parai is a Tamil frame drum: a circu: Parai ye ngoma ya fuleemu ya Tamil: fuleemu eyeetooloovu ng’erina oluwuzi olugoloddwa, ekubwa n’ebikuba mu nnyimba eziriko omusono. Erudde ng’ekola mu kulangirira, emikolo, embaga n’okuziika, era parai attam ya leero yeegatta ku kukuba endongo n’okuzina. Ebyafaayo byayo era bitwala ensengeka y’ekika eyasuula abazannyi bangi ab’obusika ku bbali — era mu buwangwa bw’Abatamil leero parai ezannyibwa okukakasa endagamuntu, ekitiibwa n’okwenkanankana.
The Periplus of the Erythraean Sea names: Ekitabo ekiyitibwa Periplus eky’ennyanja Erythraean kituuma Tyndis erinnya ly’emyalo egy’oku lubalama lw’amaserengeta, mu bwakabaka bwa kabaka Chera, era ebitabo by’Olutamil bijjukira omwalo oguyitibwa Tondi. Wa we yayimiridde tekikakasibwa: Tanur, Ponnani ne Kadalundi byonna biteeseddwa, era ekibuga eky’omulembe ekya Thondi ku lubalama lw’obugwanjuba bw’obuvanjuba bwa Tamil Nadu tekiyinza kumala gamanyibwa na buli kiwandiiko eky’edda. Tyndis etegeerekeka bulungi olw’ekifo kyayo mu myalo gy’e Malabar n’amakubo agali munda mu nnyanja emabega waago.

The ports and trading centres of ancient: Emyalo n’ebifo eby’obusuubuzi eby’edda Tamilakam — Puhar ne Arikamedu ku lubalama lw’ebuvanjuba, Korkai ne Alagankulam mu nsi ya Pandya, Muziris ne Tyndis mu maserengeta, ne Uraiyur, Karur ne Kodumanal munda mu lukalu — buli kimu mu kitabo ky’ebifaananyi eky’okusima kwayo.
The pullanguzhal, the bamboo flute, is b: Pullanguzhal, entongooli ey’emiwemba, efuuwa okuyita mu kifo ekiggule ng’engalo zibikka ne zibikkula ebituli byakyo. Mu bitontome bya Sangam entongooli ya mullai, ekifo eky’obusumba bw’abalunzi n’ebibira; leero kiwulirwa mu nnyimba z’abantu, ez’okusinza n’eza kinnansi. The poems’ pastoral flute is a literary theme, though — si bukakafu nti buli ntongooli ey’edda yali kivuga kimu.

The reverse of a coin naming Uttama Chol: Ennyuma y’effeeza eyatuumibwa erinnya Uttama Chola (c. 970–985 CE), nga ssente zaayo eza ffeeza ze zimu ku nsonga z’Abachola ezaasooka okubeera n’erinnya lya kabaka — wano mu mpandiika ya Grantha ekozesebwa mu Lusanskrit mu nsi y’Abatamil.
The reverse of a Setu coin, where the le: Emabega w’effeeza ya Setu, nga eno ewandiikiddwa olugero “Setu”. Okusoma ebiwandiiko ku maaso gombi ag’ekinusu — eky’omu maaso n’eky’emabega — y’engeri abakugu mu by’ensimbi gye bazuula ani yakifulumya ne ddi.
The revived Pandya kingdom continued to: Obwakabaka bwa Pandya obwazuukizibwa bwagenda mu maaso n’okukozesa akabonero k’ebyennyanja, ng’emirundi mingi kalaga ebyennyanja bibiri, oluusi nga birimu omuggo oba ettaala.
The ripe paddy is cut by hand with sickl: Emmwanyi enkungu bagisalibwa n’engalo n’ebiso, oluvannyuma ne bagiwuula okwawula emmere ey’empeke ku bikoola ne bagiwuuba okusobola okugogola ebisusunku. Amakungula galiisa amaka n’obutale, era ensimbi ezaava mu ttaka zaayimirizaawo obuyinza obufuga — ebyobulimi byawagira obulunzi bw’ente, okulongoosa emmere ey’empeke, entambula n’okusuubula ku mabbali gaayo.
The river that fed the Chola kingdom’s a: Omugga ogwaliisa ebyobulimi by’obwakabaka bwa Chola n’ebitontome byabwo eby’obungi.
The rock-cut and structural monuments of: Ebijjukizo eby’amayinja n’ebizimbe ebya Mamallapuram ebyayolwa wansi w’Abapallava, omuli ekifaananyi ekinene eky’obuweerero ne Rathas Etaano.
The rock-cut caves, sculptural reliefs,: Empuku ezitemeddwa mu mayinja, ebifaananyi ebibumbe, rathas eziriko amayinja agamu ne yeekaalu ezizimbibwa biwa obujulizi obutereevu ku bituukiddwaako mu by’ekikugu ebya Pallava.
The Salem silk saree is associated with: Salem silk saree ekwatagana ne Salem, ekitundu ekikulu ekikola engoye mu Tamil Nadu. Saree zino zilukibwa nga bakozesa wuzi ya silika, zijja mu langi ez’enjawulo, dizayini z’ensalosalo n’emisono egy’okuyooyoota. Endabika yazo eyinza okuva ku dizayini ennyangu era ennungi okutuuka ku ngoye ezisingako obulungi ezigendereddwamu embaga, embaga, n’emikolo emirala egy’enjawulo. Obusika bw’eby’okwambala mu Salem bukwatagana n’enkulaakulana empanvu ey’okukola silika, okuluka, n’obutale bw’engoye obw’ettunzi mu Tamil Nadu. Omulimu guno gwetaaga okukola obukugu mu kutegeka wuzi, okuteekawo engoye, okukuuma okusika omuguwa okutambula obulungi mu kuluka, n’okumaliriza olugoye. Katonda waayo ye Varunan, mukama w’amazzi, ate ekimuli kyayo ye bbululu water-lily (neithal). Omulamwa gwayo gwe irangal — anxious pining nga omuzira atunuulira ennyanja olw’eryato ly’omwagalwa we. The sea routes that joined the Tamil coa: Amakubo g’ennyanja agaagatta ku lubalama lw’ennyanja Tamil okutuuka ku nnyanja Emmyufu, Mediterranean ne South-East Asia, enzimba y’emyalo — emyalo, enzizi n’emyalo egy’amabaati — n’ebibya, ebibumba n’ebyamaguzi ebyatambuliranga wakati waabwe — nga Adichanallur, ekifo awaziikibwa mu mulembe gw’ekyuma eky’ekiwonvu kya Thamirabarani, mu bifaananyi ebisirifu ne firimu.
The secret of Kallanai’s endurance: clay: Ekyama ky’okugumiikiriza kwa Kallanai: ebbumba n’omusenyu omulungi ogwasitulibwa amataba byakolanga mu bifo ebiri wakati w’amayinja ne bisiba. Omugga gwayamba okuzimba ebbibiro lyagwo, era buli mataba agaalekanga omusenyu omuggya gazza obuggya envumbo. The shore at Poompuhar in Mayiladuthurai: Olubalama lw’ennyanja e Poompuhar mu disitulikiti y’e Mayiladuthurai, enkyukakyuka y’olubalama lw’ennyanja n’okukulugguka kw’ettaka gye bizzeemu okubumba enkula y’omwalo ogw’edda.

The Thamirabarani — known in Tamil as th: Thamirabarani — emanyiddwa mu lulimi Olutamil nga Porunai — ekulukuta n’eyita ku kifunvu ky’okuziika ng’egenda mu Gulf of Mannar. Wansi w’omugga mwalimu Korkai, omwalo gw’e Pandya ogwamanyibwa olw’amayinja gaayo aga luulu; nga firimu bw’egamba, abantu b’omu kiwonvu kino baali basobola okutuuka ku nnyanja, n’amakubo agasukkawo, nga bayita mu mugga. The thavil, closely tied to the Thanjavu: Thavil, ekwatagana nnyo n’ekitundu kya Thanjavur, ngando eringa ekipipa ng’erina omutwe ku buli nkomerero, ng’ekubiddwa n’omukono gumu ku mutwe ogumu ate omuggo omumpi ku mulala. Mu kibiina kya nadaswaram kikola kinene nnyo okusinga okukuuma obudde: abazannyi abakugu baddamu oluyimba n’enjawulo mu nnyimba n’amaanyi, mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka ekimala okukuŋŋaana ebweru n’enkuŋŋaana ennene mu yeekaalu.
The Thirubuvanam silk saree originates f: Thirubuvanam silk saree esibuka mu Thirubuvanam mu kitundu kya Thanjavur mu Tamil Nadu. Kikiikirira ennono ey’enjawulo ey’okuluka silika ng’abakozi b’emikono bakola emifaliso gya silika egya langi ez’enjawulo nga giyooyooteddwa n’ensalosalo ezilukibwa n’ebifaananyi eby’ennono. Okusinziira ku ngeri gye zikoleddwamu, saree ziyinza okubaamu emisono egy’enjawulo, langi ez’enjawulo, n’ebintu eby’okuyooyoota ebituukira ddala ku ngoye ez’ennaku enkulu n’ez’emikolo. Ennono eno eraga nti ekitundu kino kimaze ebbanga nga kikwatagana n’obukugu bw’engoye n’okutambuza okumanya okuluka okuva mu milembe. Okukola silk saree kyetaagisa obukugu mu kutegeka wuzi, okukola loom, okukola pattern, n’okumaliriza olugoye. Wadde ng’omwaka omutuufu gwe yasibuka tegunnategeerekeka, Thirubuvanam ekyali linnya ddene ery’ekitundu mu busika bwa Tamil Nadu obw’okuluka silika. Sarees zaayo ziraga engeri ebifo eby’enjawulo eby’okuluka gye byakulaakulanya emisono egy’enjawulo n’erinnya ate nga biyamba mu byafaayo ebigazi eby’engoye z’e South Buyindi.
The Thirukkural by Thiruvalluvar: 1,330: The Thirukkural eya Thiruvalluvar: 1,330 ebitabo ebibiri ebirina ennyiriri bbiri mu ssuula 133, nga byawuddwamu ebitabo bisatu — Empisa ennungi (Aram), Obugagga (Porul), n’Okwagala (Inbam). Kivvuunuddwa mu nnimi nnyingi ez’ensi.
The Thirukkural could not be opened just: Thirukkural teyasobodde kuggulwawo kati. Nsaba oggalewo omuzingo era ogezeeko nate.
The three crowned kings of the Tamil lan: Bakabaka abasatu abaali batikkiddwa engule mu nsi y’Abatamil buli omu yalina akabonero, era ssente zaabwe zizitwala: engo y’Abachola, ebyennyanja eby’Abapandya, n’obutaasa bw’Abachera. Soma wamu, obubonero buno byogera ku byafaayo by’ebyobufuzi — ekinusu ky’Abachola bwe kiraga enjovu ng’eri ku mabbali g’ebyennyanja bya Pandya n’obutaasa bwa Chera, kirangirira obumanyirivu bwa kabaka w’Abachola ku bavuganya.
The Tirukkural contains 1,330 couplets a: Tirukkural erimu ebigambo ebibiri 1,330 ebisengekeddwa mu ssuula 133. Kyawulwamu ebitundu bisatu: Empisa ennungi, Obugagga n’Okwagala. Omulimu guno gwogera ku nneeyisa y’omuntu, obulamu bw’amaka, omukwano, obuyigirize, enfuga, obwenkanya n’okusaasira.
The Tirukkural has been translated into: Tirukkural evvuunuddwa mu nnimi nnyingi, ekisobozesa ebirowoozo bya Thiruvalluvar okutuuka ku basomi okusukka ensalo z’ebiwandiiko by’Olutamil.
The Tiruvalangadu plates of Rajendra I a: Ebipande bya Tiruvalangadu ebya Rajendra I n’ebipande bya Anbil ebya Sundara Chola bye bikulu ebikwata ku lunyiriri lw’obuzaale n’ebyafaayo by’olulyo lwa Chola.
The Tolkappiyam by Tolkappiyar is the ol: Tolkappiyam eya Tolkappiyar ye grammar y’Olutamil esinga obukadde. Ebitabo byayo ebisatu bikwata ku nnukuta n’amaloboozi (Ezhuthu), ebigambo (Sol), n’ensonga ezikwata ku bulamu n’ebitontome (Porul).
The udukkai is a small hourglass-shaped: Udukkai kidongo kitono ekiringa essaawa, emitwe gyayo ebiri nga gigattibwako emiguwa egy’okusika; okusika emiguwa kiyinza okukyusa eddoboozi. Ekwatibwa mu mukono gumu n’okukubwa n’omulala, ewerekera ennyimba ez’okusinza, ennyiriri z’abantu n’okuzannya emikolo — okujjukiza engeri okukuba, okwewaayo n’okuyimba mu kamwa gye bisibiddwa wamu.
The ural and ulakkai were used to pound: Ural ne ulakkai zaakozesebwanga okukuba omuceere, emmwaanyi, empeke n’eby’akaloosa. Ural yali kibya kigumu, nga kitera okukolebwa mu mbaawo oba mu mayinja, ate nga ulakkai kyali kikozesebwa kiwanvu ekikuba. Bombi, baayambako okuggyamu ebikuta, okumenya emmere ey’empeke n’okuteekateeka ebirungo by’okufumba. Ebikozesebwa era biraga kaweefube w’omubiri n’omulimu ogw’okugabana oguzingirwa mu kutegeka emmere ey’ekinnansi.
The veenai (Saraswati veena) is one of t: Veenai (Saraswati veena) kye kimu ku bivuga ebikulu eby’enkoba mu muziki gwa South Indian classical: ekyuma ekinene eky’embaawo ekiwuuma, ensingo empanvu eriko ebiwujjo, ennanga n’ebipiira ebiwunyiriza, ebiseera ebisinga nga kiriko eddoboozi ery’okubiri. Okunyiga n’okuserengesa emiguwa ku biwujjo kiwa omuziki gwa Carnatic eby’okwewunda byagwo ebirungi. Nga ekwatagana ne Saraswati, katonda omukazi ow’okuyiga, erina okwawulwa ku yazh ey’edda — efaanagana mu kifo, naye si muzzukulu waayo obutereevu.
The walls of the Brihadeeswarar temple c: Bbugwe wa yeekaalu ya Brihadeeswarar kuliko ebiwandiiko ebiwanvu ebya Rajaraja I nga biwandiika endowments, abakozi ba yeekaalu, amayinja ag’omuwendo, n’ebirabo — ekiwandiiko ekyewuunyisa ku yeekaalu ng’ekitongole.
The wooden plough, often drawn by cattle: Enkumbi ey’embaawo, etera okusimbulwa ente oba enyanja, yakozesebwanga okusumulula n’okuteekateeka ettaka ly’ebyobulimi okusiga. Ng’erina ebikozesebwa mu ngalo eby’okusimba n’okusaawa, ebiso eby’okukungula, n’okuwuula n’okuwunyiriza okuyonja emmere ey’empeke, kyali kya bikozesebwa ebitundu by’abalimi bye byamanyiira ettaka n’ebirime byabwe ne biyita okuva ku mulembe ogumu okudda ku mulala.
The woodland and pastures, in the evenin: Ebibira n’amalundiro, akawungeezi mu biseera by’enkuba. Katonda waayo ye Mayon (Thirumal), ate ekimuli kyayo ye jasmine (mullai). Omulamwa gwayo gwa iruthal — okulinda okugumiikiriza, nga omuzira bw’alinda bba okudda nga enkuba tennatonnya. Abantu baayo balunzi abalunda ente n’okusiimuula ebikuta ne butto.
The works that arrange their verses land: Ebikolwa ebisengeka ennyiriri zaabwe enkula y’ensi okusinziira ku nkula y’ensi — Ainkurunuru, Aintinai Aimpathu ne Ezhupathu, Tinaimozhi Aimpathu, Tinaimalai Nurraimpathu ne Kainnilai — mu bibinja by’amakoola g’enkindu mwe byakoppololwa.
The world-famous Chola bronzes: how they: Ebikomo bya Chola ebimanyiddwa mu nsi yonna: engeri gye byakolebwamu enkola ya lost-wax, ekifaananyi kya Nataraja, n’omulimu gw’emikono omulamu ogwa Swamimalai.
The yazh is one of the most distinctive: Yazh kye kimu ku bivuga ebisinga okwawukana mu biwandiiko by’Olutamil eby’edda: ekivuga eky’enkoba ezisimbuddwa, mu bugazi ng’ennanga eriko enkokola. Ebikolwa bya Sangam nga Perumpanatrupadai, ne Silappatikaram, bibinnyonnyola, era biba bya panar, abayimbi abaagatta ebitontome ku muziki. Abamanyi batuuma amannya g’ebika ebiwerako — periyazh, siriyazh, sakota yazh ne vil yazh — ng’enzimba yazo entuufu ebiwandiiko tebiraga mu bujjuvu, kale yazh yonna erabibwa leero ya kuzimba buggya. Kivuga mu ngeri yaakyo, so si veenai yokka eyasooka.
These are food traditions associated wit: Zino nnono za mmere ezikwatagana n’ebifo n’ebitundu by’ebiwandiiko by’e Sangam, so si menu ezitakyukakyuka ezigobererwa buli muntu. Abantu bye balya byawukana okusinziira ku biseera, ekitundu, sizoni n’obusuubuzi. Ebifaananyi bya mulembe nga biddamu okuzimba emmere ebiwandiiko gye byogerako, so si mmere ya dda.
Thirugnanasambandar, the 7th-century chi: Thirugnanasambandar, omwana omutukuvu ow’omu kyasa eky’omusanvu, omu ku ba Shaiva Nayanmars abakulu ennyimba ze eziggulawo Tevaram. Ebikomo bya Chola bimulaga ng’omulenzi omuto ng’azina mu ssanyu, engalo ye ey’omukono ng’ewanise eri Shiva, eyali — emboozi bw’egamba — eyali amuwadde amata ag’amagezi okuva mu bbeere lya Parvati.
Thirumalai Nayak Palace represents the a: Olubiri lwa Thirumalai Nayak lukiikirira ekitiibwa ky’ebizimbe, obuwangwa bw’obwakabaka n’ebyafaayo by’ebyobufuzi eby’omulembe gwa Madurai Nayak.
Thirumalai Nayak Palace was constructed: Olubiri lwa Thirumalai Nayak lwazimbibwa mu kyasa eky’ekkumi n’omusanvu ku mulembe gwa Kabaka Thirumalai Nayak ow’olulyo lwa Madurai Nayak. Olubiri luno lwakola ng’amaka g’obwakabaka era ng’ekifo ekikulu eky’obulamu bw’omu lubiri. Enzimba yaayo yagatta empagi ez’amaanyi, ebisenge ebigazi, ebintu eby’okuyooyoota n’ebintu ebikwatagana n’omulembe gwa Nayak. Ebyafaayo biraga nti ekizimbe ky’olubiri ekyasooka kyali kinene okusinga ebitundu ebikyaliyo leero.
Thirumurugatrupadai, Porunaratrupadai, S: Thirumurugatrupadai, Porunaratrupadai, Sirupanatrupadai, Perumpanatrupadai, Mullaippattu, Maduraikkanchi, Nedunalvadai, Kurinjippattu, Pattinappalai, ne Malaipadukadam. Thiruvalluvar is celebrated as one of th: Thiruvalluvar akuzibwa ng’omu ku bayimbi abasinga obukulu mu biwandiiko by’Olutamil. Mu buwangwa ayitibwa nti ye yayiiya ekitabo kya Tirukkural, ekitabo ekimanyiddwa ennyo eky’Olutamil ekinoonyereza ku bintu bisatu ebikulu eby’obulamu bw’omuntu: empisa ennungi, obugagga n’okwagala.
Thiruvalluvar occupies an important plac: Thiruvalluvar erina ekifo ekikulu mu biwandiiko n’obuwangwa bw’Abatamil. Ekibumbe kino eky’ekijjukizo e Kanyakumari ne Valluvar Kottam mu kibuga Chennai bye bimu ku bijjukizo ebikulu ebyamuweereddwayo.
Thiruvalluvar’s 1330 couplets on virtue,: Ebitabo bya Thiruvalluvar ebya 1330 ebikwata ku mpisa ennungi, obugagga n’okwagala, byakoppa n’ennyonnyola y’ekyasa eky’ekkumi n’esatu eya Parimelazhagar, esinga okusomesebwa mu nnyinnyonnyola ez’edda.
Thiruvalluvar’s teachings encourage peop: Enjigiriza za Thiruvalluvar zikubiriza abantu okubeera mu bwesimbu, okuyisa abalala mu ngeri ey’ekisa n’okukola mu bwenkanya. Ebigambo bye ebibiri tebikoma ku kiseera kimu oba ekitundu kimu; emirembe gy’abasomi gyeyongedde okuzisoma n’okuzisiima.

Today, Keezhadi is recognised as an impo: Leero, Keezhadi emanyiddwa ng’ekifo ekikulu eky’okukuula eby’edda. Ebifo eby’okusima, myuziyamu n’okwolesebwa kw’ebintu ebizuuliddwa biyamba abagenyi okumanya ebyafaayo by’okusenga mu kitundu kino eby’edda. Abakugu mu by’okukuula eby’edda bakyagenda mu maaso n’okunoonyereza ku bujulizi okutegeera ensengeka y’ebiseera ekifo kino n’enkolagana y’obuwangwa.
Today, Madurai is one of Tamil Nadu’s ma: Leero, Madurai kye kimu ku bibuga ebikulu eby’obuwangwa n’eddiini mu Tamil Nadu. Yeekaalu ya Meenakshi Amman kye kifo kyayo ekisinga okumanyibwa, esikiriza abalamazi n’abagenyi okuva mu Buyindi yonna n’ebweru w’eggwanga. Ekibuga kino kikyali kimanyiddwa olw’embaga za yeekaalu, obutale bw’ennono, emmere, emirimu gy’emikono n’ebyobuwangwa by’Abatamil.
Today, Mamallapuram is a major heritage: Leero, Mamallapuram kifo kikulu eky’obusika ku lubalama lw’ennyanja Coromandel mu Tamil Nadu. Abagenyi basobola okwekenneenya ebijjukizo byayo eby’edda, ebibumbe eby’amayinja, amasinzizo n’ebifo ebiri ku lubalama lw’ennyanja. Ekibinja ky’ebijjukizo e Mahabalipuram kimanyiddwa ng’ekifo eky’omugaso mu nsi yonna ekya UNESCO.
Today, the palace is a prominent heritag: Leero, olubiri luno kifo kya busika ekimanyiddwa ennyo mu Madurai. Abagenyi basobola okwegomba empagi zaayo ez’ekijjukizo, oluggya olunene, ebisenge ebiwanvu n’ebizimbe ebisigaddewo. Omukutu guno gukuwa omukisa okuyiga ku bulamu bw’obwakabaka obw’omulembe gwa Nayak n’ennono z’eby’ekikugu ezaali mu Tamil Nadu ey’omulembe guno eyasooka.
Today, the principal surviving landmark: Leero, ekifo ekikulu ekikyaliyo ye Yeekaalu ya Gangaikondacholeeswaram. Vimana yaayo empanvu, ebibumbe, amayinja n’ensengeka y’ebizimbe bigifuula ekimu ku bijjukizo ebikulu ebikyaliyo eby’ebizimbe by’Abachola. Trade went on, but its places and partne: Obusuubuzi bwagenda mu maaso, naye ebifo byayo n’emikwano gyabyo byakyuka: okukendeera kw’omwalo gumu tekwakoma ku kugenda ku nnyanja mu Tamil. Mu kiseera kya Pallavas n’oluvannyuma aba Cholas ab’obwakabaka, ebibiina by’abasuubuzi n’emyalo egy’oku lubalama lw’ebuvanjuba nga Nagapattinam byatwala obusuubuzi bw’Abatamil okuyita mu Bay of Bengal okutuuka mu South-East Asia — essuula eyaddirira okusinga obusuubuzi bwa Indo-Roman. Okwegendereza kuyita mu byonna: olunaku ekitontome lwe kyawandiikibwa, emyaka gye kyogerako n’ekiseera ky’eby’okukuula eby’edda ku mwalo tebitera kufaanagana.
Traditional author of Silappathikaram, t: Omuwandiisi w’ennono owa Silappathikaram, The Tale of the Anklet — emboozi ya Kannagi ne Kovalan, nga bayita mu Puhar, Madurai ne Vanchi, n’okwekenneenya okunoonya obwenkanya n’obwakabaka. Ennono emufuula omulangira Chera, muganda wa Senguttuvan, eyava ku ntebe; kino tekiyinza kukakasibwa mu bwetwaze.
Traditional beverages included buttermil: Ebyokunywa eby’ekinnansi mwalimu butto n’ebyokunywa ebyategekebwa okuva mu birungo ebiri mu kitundu. Mu bitundu ebirimibwa enkindu, n’omubisi gw’enkindu omuggya ogumanyiddwa nga padaneer nagwo gwaliibwa. Ebyokunywa ebizimbulukuse byaliwo mu mbeera ezimu ez’ebyafaayo, naye ebirungo byabyo n’enkozesa yaabyo byawukana okusinziira ku kitundu n’ekiseera.
Traditional Tamil agriculture relied on: Obulimi obw’ekinnansi obw’Abatamil bwasigama ku bikozesebwa ebyakolebwa okuteekateeka ettaka, okusiga ensigo, okuggyawo omuddo, okukungula ebirime, n’okulongoosa emmere ey’empeke. Enkumbi ey’embaawo, etera okusimbulwa ente oba enyanja, yakozesebwanga okusumulula n’okuteekateeka ettaka ly’ebyobulimi. Ebikozesebwa mu ngalo byayamba abalimi okukola emirimu gy’okusimba n’okuddaabiriza, ate nga n’ebiso byakozesebwanga okukungula ebirime. Oluvannyuma lw’okukungula, emmere ey’empeke yayawulwanga ku bikoola nga bayita mu kuwuula ne bayonjebwa nga bayita mu kuwunyiriza. Ebyuma eby’ennono eby’okusitula amazzi nabyo byayamba abalimi okuleeta amazzi okuva mu nzizi, mu bidiba ne ttanka mu nnimiro zaabwe. Ebikozesebwa n’obukodyo obutuufu byawukana okusinziira ku kirime, ekitundu, n’ekiseera ky’ebyafaayo. Ebikozesebwa bino biraga engeri ebitundu by’abalimi gye byakola tekinologiya ow’omugaso akwatagana n’embeera z’ekitundu ne bayisa okumanya kw’ebyobulimi okuva ku mulembe ogumu okudda ku mulala.
Traditionally the author of the Tholkapp: Mu nnono omuwandiisi wa Tholkappiyam, grammar y’Olutamil esinga obukadde, mu bitundu bisatu — Ezhuthu (ennukuta), Sol (ebigambo) ne Porul (ensonga), nga eno enjawukana za akam ne puram n’ebifaananyi bya thinai eby’ebitontome eby’edda biteekeddwateekeddwa. Olunaku lwayo n’obuwandiisi bwayo bikyakubaganyizibwako ebirowoozo.
Ebika by’obujulizi bibiri bisisinkana mu kisenge kino. Water management has played a major role: Enzirukanya y’amazzi ekoze kinene mu byafaayo by’ebyobulimi mu Tamil Nadu kubanga enkuba etonnya mu sizoni n’ebitundu. Okufukirira okw’ekinnansi kukyali nsonga nkulu mu kutegeera enkolagana wakati w’ebyobulimi, yinginiya, okusenga, n’okukyusakyusa obutonde bw’ensi mu Tamil Nadu.
